youtube_title_en: 800 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Flat-Pack Furniture
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用「組裝傢俱」情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫）。場景是週末的客廳地板：開箱點清螺絲袋與板材、對著說明書圖找第一步、翻抽屜找十字螺絲起子、發現孔位對不太上、請樓上的朋友來扶住高側板、發覺背板裝反了只好再拆一次、鎖上最後一塊板、把書放好再拍一張照。800 句循環聽，A2 程度，零基礎也能跟著開口說。常用句型包含數零件、講工具、請人幫忙、檢查穩不穩。#英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical 'Flat-Pack Furniture' phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue). The scene is a living-room floor on a weekend: opening the boxes and counting screw bags, finding step one in the manual, hunting for a cross-head screwdriver, holes that do not line up, a friend holding the tall side panel, finding out the back board went on backwards, driving the last screws, then shelving the books and taking one photo. 800 lines on repeat, A2 level, easy to repeat out loud even from zero.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you check the box number?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju tʃɛk ðə bɑks ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 你核對過箱號了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one says A four on top.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn sɛz eɪ fɔr ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 這一箱頂部寫著 A4。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are all four boxes flat on the floor?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ɔl fɔr ˈbɑksɪz flæt ɑn ðə flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 四個箱子都平放在地上了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two are flat, two are on edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ɑr flæt tu ɑr ɑn ɛʤ/
dialogue.zh: 兩個平躺，兩個立著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's open the tallest box first.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ˈoʊpən ðə ˈtɔləst bɑks fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 我們先打開最高的那一個箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I will hand you the scissors.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪ wɪl hænd ju ðə ˈsɪzərz/
dialogue.zh: 好，我把剪刀遞給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you get the knife from the kitchen?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ɡɛt ðə naɪf frʌm ðə ˈkɪtʃən/
dialogue.zh: 你能從廚房拿小刀來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here it is, with the brown handle.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz wɪð ðə braʊn ˈhændəl/
dialogue.zh: 就在這裡，棕色手柄這一把。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not cut toward your fingers.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt kʌt təˈwɔrd jɔr ˈfɪŋɡərz/
dialogue.zh: 割的時候別朝著手指。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know, I cut along the tape.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ aɪ kʌt əˈlɔŋ ðə teɪp/
dialogue.zh: 我知道，我是順著膠帶割的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is under this thick paper?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ˈʌndər ðɪs θɪk ˈpeɪpər/
dialogue.zh: 這層厚紙下面是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Foam pieces, all in a row.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊm ˈpisɪz ɔl ɪn ə roʊ/
dialogue.zh: 是泡棉塊，一排排塞著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pull the foam out, it is stuck.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ðə foʊm aʊt ɪt ɪz stʌk/
dialogue.zh: 把泡棉拉出來，它卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I pulled one side, now it moves.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pʊld wʌn saɪd naʊ ɪt muvz/
dialogue.zh: 我拉了一邊，現在它動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, plastic bags full of screws.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ˈplæstɪk bæɡz fʊl əv skrʊz/
dialogue.zh: 你看，塑膠袋裡裝滿螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each bag has a printed number.
dialogue.phonetic: /itʃ bæɡ hæz ə ˈprɪntɪd ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 每一個袋子都印了編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many small bags are inside?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni smɔl bæɡz ɑr ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 裡面有幾個小袋子？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four bags, numbered one to four.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr bæɡz ˈnʌmbərd wʌn tu fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 四袋，編號一到四。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bag one is the long silver screws.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæɡ wʌn ɪz ðə lɔŋ ˈsɪlvər skrʊz/
dialogue.zh: 一號袋是長的銀色螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bag two holds the short black ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæɡ tu hoʊldz ðə ʃɔrt blæk wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 二號袋裝短的黑色那些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the washers in bag three?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə ˈwɑʃərz ɪn bæɡ θri/
dialogue.zh: 墊片放在三號袋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plus six round metal caps.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs plʌs sɪks raʊnd ˈmɛtəl kæps/
dialogue.zh: 有，另外六個圓的金屬帽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about bag four, the little pegs?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt əˈbaʊt bæɡ fɔr ðə ˈlɪtəl pɛɡz/
dialogue.zh: 那四號袋，小木釘呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight wooden pegs, but two look broken.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ˈwʊdən pɛɡz bʌt tu lʊk ˈbroʊkən/
dialogue.zh: 八根木釘，有兩根看起來斷了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Broken pegs? Then we need new ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbroʊkən pɛɡz ðɛn wi nid nju wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 木釘斷了？那我們需要新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two more are hiding under the foam.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɔr ɑr ˈhaɪdɪŋ ˈʌndər ðə foʊm/
dialogue.zh: 還有兩根藏在泡棉下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read the part list at the front.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ðə pɑrt lɪst æt ðə frʌnt/
dialogue.zh: 先看最前面的零件清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Side panel A, side panel B, five shelves.
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪd ˈpænəl eɪ saɪd ˈpænəl bi faɪv ʃɛlvz/
dialogue.zh: 側板A、側板B、五塊層板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we have five shelves in here?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi hæv faɪv ʃɛlvz ɪn hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這邊真的有五塊層板嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I found four, flat against the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ faʊnd fɔr flæt əˈɡɛnst ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 我只找到四塊，平貼著箱壁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fifth shelf is leaning in back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɪfθ ʃɛlf ɪz ˈlinɪŋ ɪn bæk/
dialogue.zh: 第五塊斜靠在箱子最深處。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, now the count is right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt naʊ ðə kaʊnt ɪz raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，現在數目對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count the boards again, slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ðə bɔrdz əˈɡɛn ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 板子再慢慢數一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two long sides, five shelves, one back.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu lɔŋ saɪdz faɪv ʃɛlvz wʌn bæk/
dialogue.zh: 兩塊長側板、五塊層板、一塊背板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that thin board the back piece?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt θɪn bɔrd ðə bæk pis/
dialogue.zh: 那片薄薄的就是背板嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it is soft like thick cardboard.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt ɪz sɔft laɪk θɪk ˈkɑrdˌbɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 對，摸起來像厚紙板一樣軟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peel the clear film off this shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /pil ðə klɪr fɪlm ɔf ðɪs ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 把這塊層板的透明膜撕掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It comes off in one long strip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kʌmz ɔf ɪn wʌn lɔŋ strɪp/
dialogue.zh: 一整條就撕下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not throw the film away yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt θroʊ ðə fɪlm əˈweɪ jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 先別急著把膜丟掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why? Should we keep the trash?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ʃʊd wi kip ðə træʃ/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼？要留著垃圾嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lay the film flat to catch dust.
dialogue.phonetic: /leɪ ðə fɪlm flæt tu kætʃ dʌst/
dialogue.zh: 把膜平鋪著接灰塵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, the floor is very dusty.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt ðə flɔr ɪz ˈvɛri ˈdʌsti/
dialogue.zh: 聰明，地板上很多灰。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check the shelf edges for scratches.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə ʃɛlf ˈɛdʒɪz fɔr ˈskrætʃəz/
dialogue.zh: 檢查層板邊緣有沒有刮傷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This corner has one white mark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈkɔrnər hæz wʌn waɪt mɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 這角落有一道白色的痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the mark deep or only on top?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə mɑrk dip ɔr ˈoʊnli ɑn tɑp/
dialogue.zh: 那條痕很深，還是只在表面？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only the color, the wood is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ðə ˈkʌlər ðə wʊd ɪz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 只傷到顏色，木頭本身還好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My thumb fits in the little chip.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ θʌm fɪts ɪn ðə ˈlɪtəl tʃɪp/
dialogue.zh: 我的拇指剛好卡進那個缺角。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is damage, we should tell the shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈdæmɪdʒ wi ʃʊd tɛl ðə ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 那算損壞，得跟店家說一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take a photo of the chipped corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ðə tʃɪpt ˈkɔrnər/
dialogue.zh: 幫缺角的那一邊拍張照。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One photo now, and one of the label.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈfoʊtoʊ naʊ ænd wʌn əv ðə ˈleɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 先拍缺角，再拍那張標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which label do you mean, the barcode?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈleɪbəl du ju min ðə ˈbɑrˌkoʊd/
dialogue.zh: 哪張標籤，條碼那張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The sticker with the model number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈstɪkər wɪð ðə ˈmɑdəl ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 有型號數字的那張貼紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is, on the side panel.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz ɑn ðə saɪd ˈpænəl/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，貼在側板上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now we send both photos to the shop.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ wi sɛnd boʊθ ˈfoʊtoʊz tu ðə ʃɑp/
dialogue.zh: 現在我們把兩張照片都傳給店家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, the manual is missing from the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ðə ˈmænjuəl ɪz ˈmɪsɪŋ frʌm ðə bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 等等，箱子裡少了說明書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the folded paper in the lid.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə ˈfoʊldəd ˈpeɪpər ɪn ðə lɪd/
dialogue.zh: 看看箱蓋裡那張摺好的紙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, printed on one big sheet.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt ˈprɪntɪd ɑn wʌn bɪɡ ʃit/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，印在一張大紙上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It has drawings, but no words.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hæz ˈdrɔɪŋz bʌt noʊ wɜrdz/
dialogue.zh: 上面只有圖，沒有一個字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the arrows are all we get.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ði ˈæroʊz ɑr ɔl wi ɡɛt/
dialogue.zh: 那就只能靠那些箭頭了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, pictures are easy to follow.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn ˈpɪktʃərz ɑr ˈizi tu ˈfɑloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，看圖反而簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The table is covered with parts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈteɪbəl ɪz ˈkʌvərd wɪθ pɑrts/
dialogue.zh: 桌子上面全是零件。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move the bags to the floor edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ðə bæɡz tu ðə flɔr ɛʤ/
dialogue.zh: 把袋子搬到地板邊就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the sheet lies flat on the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ʃit laɪz flæt ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 現在那張紙在桌上攤平了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I smoothed the corner, it was curled.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ smʊðd ðə ˈkɔrnər ɪt wʌz kɜld/
dialogue.zh: 我把翹的角壓平了，它剛剛是捲著的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some pegs rolled under the sofa.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm pɛɡz roʊld ˈʌndər ðə ˈsoʊfə/
dialogue.zh: 有幾根木釘滾到沙發底下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I got three, do you see more?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ɡɑt θri du ju si mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 我摸到三根，還看得到別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two more are near the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mɔr ɑr nɪr ðə wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 還有兩根在牆壁那一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put them in the yellow cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðɛm ɪn ðə ˈjɛloʊ kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 把它們放進黃色那個杯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cup keeps the screws together.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kʌp kips ðə skrʊz təˈɡɛðər/
dialogue.zh: 用杯子裝，螺絲就不會散。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better than loose on the rug.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər ðæn lus ɑn ðə rʌɡ/
dialogue.zh: 比這樣散在地毯上還好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did a screw go into the carpet?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ə skrʊ ɡoʊ ˈɪntu ðə ˈkɑrpɪt/
dialogue.zh: 有沒有一顆螺絲掉進地毯？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I felt one under my shoe.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fɛlt wʌn ˈʌndər maɪ ʃu/
dialogue.zh: 我腳底踩到了一顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shake the bag and look inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃeɪk ðə bæɡ ænd lʊk ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 搖一搖袋子，再看看裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty, all the pegs are here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmpti ɔl ðə pɛɡz ɑr hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 是空的，木釘全在這裡了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are both side panels the same size?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr boʊθ saɪd ˈpænəlz ðə seɪm saɪz/
dialogue.zh: 兩塊側板的大小是一樣的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same length, but one has more holes.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm ˈlɛŋθ bʌt wʌn hæz mɔr hoʊlz/
dialogue.zh: 長度一樣，但一塊的孔比較多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which side gets the extra holes?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ saɪd ɡɛts ði ˈɛkstrə hoʊlz/
dialogue.zh: 多出來的孔應該朝哪一邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The manual marks it with a star.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmænjuəl mɑrks ɪt wɪð ə stɑr/
dialogue.zh: 說明書用一個星號標出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A small star, right, on panel B.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl stɑr raɪt ɑn ˈpænəl bi/
dialogue.zh: 小小的星號，對，在B板那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now I know which way it faces.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ noʊ wɪtʃ weɪ ɪt ˈfeɪsəz/
dialogue.zh: 現在我知道它要朝哪一邊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stack the empty boxes by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /stæk ði ˈɛmpti ˈbɑksɪz baɪ ðə dɔr/
dialogue.zh: 空紙箱疊好放在門邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Later we need them for trash.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪtər wi nid ðɛm fɔr træʃ/
dialogue.zh: 等一下還要用它們裝垃圾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need gloves for this job?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid ɡlʌvz fɔr ðɪs dʒɑb/
dialogue.zh: 這份工作需要戴手套嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only for the rough board edges.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli fɔr ðə rʌf bɔrd ˈɛdʒɪz/
dialogue.zh: 只有粗糙的板緣需要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: These boards are heavier than they look.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz bɔrdz ɑr ˈhɛviər ðæn ðeɪ lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 這些板子比看起來更重。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your time, do not lift alone.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔr taɪm du nɑt lɪft əˈloʊn/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，彆一個人硬搬。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One panel needs two people, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈpænəl nidz tu ˈpipəl aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 一塊板子要兩個人，我覺得。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two people and one careful turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈpipəl ænd wʌn ˈkɛrfəl tɜrn/
dialogue.zh: 兩個人，再加上一次小心的翻身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the panel down on the blanket.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ðə ˈpænəl daʊn ɑn ðə ˈblæŋkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 把板子放到毯子上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The blanket keeps the paint safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈblæŋkɪt kips ðə peɪnt seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 毯子可以保護板子的漆面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything is out except the last box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɪz aʊt ɪkˈsɛpt ðə læst bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 除了最後一箱都拿出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open it, we need the feet first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ɪt wi nid ðə fit fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 打開它吧，我們先需要腳墊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four round feet, with black rubber tops.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr raʊnd fit wɪð blæk ˈrʌbər tɑps/
dialogue.zh: 四個圓腳墊，上面是黑橡膠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These twist, so the shelf can level.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðiz twɪst soʊ ðə ʃɛlf kæn ˈlɛvəl/
dialogue.zh: 它們可以轉，層板才調得平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do we know the screw count?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du wi noʊ ðə skrʊ kaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 我們怎麼知道要幾顆螺絲？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each bag lists the exact number.
dialogue.phonetic: /itʃ bæɡ lɪsts ði ɪɡˈzækt ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 每一袋都寫了確實的數量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we are one short of four.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi ɑr wʌn ʃɔrt əv fɔr/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就少了一顆，應該四顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check inside the fold of the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ɪnˈsaɪd ðə foʊld əv ðə bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 檢查一下袋子摺起來的地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Found it, stuck to the plastic wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt stʌk tu ðə ˈplæstɪk wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，黏在塑膠袋壁上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Now we have four exactly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ wi hæv fɔr ɪɡˈzæktli/
dialogue.zh: 很好，現在剛好四顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which page shows step one?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ peɪʤ ʃoʊz stɛp wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 哪一頁畫著第一步？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Page two, under the folded line.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪʤ tu ˈʌndər ðə ˈfoʊldəd laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 第二頁，在折線那下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me the drawing with the two sides.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊ mi ðə ˈdrɔɪŋ wɪð ðə tu saɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 給我看那張有兩塊側板的圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one, see the panel marked A?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn si ðə ˈpænəl mɑrkt eɪ/
dialogue.zh: 這張，看到標A的板子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, panel A stands straight up here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ˈpænəl eɪ stændz streɪt ʌp hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 看到了，A板在圖裡是豎著的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then step one is a side panel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn stɛp wʌn ɪz ə saɪd ˈpænəl/
dialogue.zh: 那第一步就是用一塊側板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the arrow pointing down or in?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ði ˈæroʊ ˈpɔɪntɪŋ daʊn ɔr ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 這個箭頭是朝下還是朝裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It points into the shelf holes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt pɔɪnts ˈɪntu ðə ʃɛlf hoʊlz/
dialogue.zh: 它對著層板那些孔指進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the shelf slides in from here?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ʃɛlf slaɪdz ɪn frʌm hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 所以層板是從這個方向滑進去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, line the pins, then push.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs laɪn ðə pɪnz ðɛn pʊʃ/
dialogue.zh: 對，先把榫釘對好，再推。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the picture shows three small dots.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðə ˈpɪktʃər ʃoʊz θri smɔl dɑts/
dialogue.zh: 你看，這張圖上有三個小圓點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dots mean the hole numbers, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɑts min ðə hoʊl ˈnʌmbərz aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 圓點應該就是孔的編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hole one, hole two, hole three.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊl wʌn hoʊl tu hoʊl θri/
dialogue.zh: 一號孔、二號孔、三號孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count them from the top edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ðɛm frʌm ðə tɑp ɛʤ/
dialogue.zh: 從最上面那條邊開始數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you circle hole two in pencil?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju ˈsɜrkəl hoʊl tu ɪn ˈpɛnsəl/
dialogue.zh: 你能用鉛筆圈出二號孔嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Circle it? Will that leave a mark?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɜrkəl ɪt wɪl ðæt liv ə mɑrk/
dialogue.zh: 圈起來？那樣會不會留痕？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Light marks are fine, we wipe later.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪt mɑrks ɑr faɪn wi waɪp ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 輕輕畫沒關係，等一下擦掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, hole two is marked now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ hoʊl tu ɪz mɑrkt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，二號孔已經圈起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does this black symbol mean?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz ðɪs blæk ˈsɪmbəl min/
dialogue.zh: 這個黑色符號是什麼意思？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It means turn the panel this way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt minz tɜrn ðə ˈpænəl ðɪs weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 意思是板子要這樣翻方向。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the printed side out or in?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə ˈprɪntɪd saɪd aʊt ɔr ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 印有紋路的那一面要朝外還是朝內？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The drawing shows the smooth side out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdrɔɪŋ ʃoʊz ðə smuð saɪd aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 圖裡畫的是光滑面朝外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then we still have panel B flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi stɪl hæv ˈpænəl bi flæt/
dialogue.zh: 那B板現在還平躺在地上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stand it up after we read step two.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd ɪt ʌp ˈæftər wi rid stɛp tu/
dialogue.zh: 看完第二步再把它立起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Step two, what does it ask first?
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp tu wʌt dʌz ɪt æsk fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 第二步，它先要我們做什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It asks for two wooden pegs.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt æskz fɔr tu ˈwʊdən pɛɡz/
dialogue.zh: 它要兩根木釘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pegs go in the holes on A?
dialogue.phonetic: /pɛɡz ɡoʊ ɪn ðə hoʊlz ɑn eɪ/
dialogue.zh: 木釘是插進A板的孔嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, two pegs near the bottom edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu pɛɡz nɪr ðə ˈbɑtəm ɛʤ/
dialogue.zh: 對，靠近下緣的那兩個孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They are tight, I need my palm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ɑr taɪt aɪ nid maɪ pɑm/
dialogue.zh: 插得好緊，我得用掌心壓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try a gentle twist, do not force.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ə ˈʤɛntəl twɪst du nɑt fɔrs/
dialogue.zh: 輕輕轉著放，不要硬壓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One is in, one is still out.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɪz ɪn wʌn ɪz stɪl aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 一根進去了，另一根還在外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push the peg straight, not sideways.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ðə pɛɡ streɪt nɑt ˈsaɪdwɛɪz/
dialogue.zh: 木釘要直直地推，不要推斜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Straight in. There, both are level.
dialogue.phonetic: /streɪt ɪn ðɛr boʊθ ɑr ˈlɛvəl/
dialogue.zh: 直直推進去了，兩根都齊平了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the drawing shows the screw holes.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə ˈdrɔɪŋ ʃoʊz ðə skrʊ hoʊlz/
dialogue.zh: 現在這張圖畫的是螺絲孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many screws in step three?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni skrʊz ɪn stɛp θri/
dialogue.zh: 第三步要幾顆螺絲？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four long ones from bag one.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr lɔŋ wʌnz frʌm bæɡ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 一號袋的四顆長螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bag one has five, so one is extra.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæɡ wʌn hæz faɪv soʊ wʌn ɪz ˈɛkstrə/
dialogue.zh: 一號袋有五顆，所以多一顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Keep it, we may need one more.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ɪt wi meɪ nid wʌn mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 留著那顆，說不定還要多鎖一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where does the first screw go?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dʌz ðə fɜrst skrʊ ɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 第一顆螺絲要鎖在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Into the top hole on panel B.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɪntu ðə tɑp hoʊl ɑn ˈpænəl bi/
dialogue.zh: 鎖進B板最上面那個孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The picture is tiny and blurry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpɪktʃər ɪz ˈtaɪni ænd ˈblɜri/
dialogue.zh: 那張圖實在又小又模糊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use your phone to take a closer photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz jɔr foʊn tu teɪk ə ˈkloʊsər ˈfoʊtoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 用手機拍一張近一點的照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Closer now, I see the hole numbers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkloʊsər naʊ aɪ si ðə hoʊl ˈnʌmbərz/
dialogue.zh: 近了，我看清楚孔的編號了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read them to me, I hold the board.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ðɛm tu mi aɪ hoʊld ðə bɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 你唸給我聽，我壓住板子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Holes two, four and seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊlz tu fɔr ænd ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 是二號、四號、七號孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three holes, not four like before.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri hoʊlz nɑt fɔr laɪk bɪˈfɔr/
dialogue.zh: 三個孔，不像剛才那樣是四個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we on the wrong page?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr wi ɑn ðə rɔŋ peɪʤ/
dialogue.zh: 是我們看錯頁了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, this page is for the tall model.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðɪs peɪʤ ɪz fɔr ðə tɔl ˈmɑdəl/
dialogue.zh: 對，這一頁是高款式的說明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flip back one page, please slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /flɪp bæk wʌn peɪʤ pliz ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 往回翻一頁，動作慢一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, step four, the shelf support.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr stɛp fɔr ðə ʃɛlf səˈpɔrt/
dialogue.zh: 這裡，第四步，層板的支撐片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Supports are those flat metal pieces?
dialogue.phonetic: /səˈpɔrtərz ɑr ðoz flæt ˈmɛtəl ˈpisəz/
dialogue.zh: 支撐片就是那些扁扁的金屬片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two per shelf, holes facing down.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu pɜr ʃɛlf hoʊlz ˈfeɪsɪŋ daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 每一層兩片，孔要朝下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the metal parts face the back?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðə ˈmɛtəl pɑrts feɪs ðə bæk/
dialogue.zh: 這些金屬片要朝後面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, they face the open front.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ðeɪ feɪs ði ˈoʊpən frʌnt/
dialogue.zh: 不，要朝著開口的前面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which way is the open front, again?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ weɪ ɪz ði ˈoʊpən frʌnt əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 再問一次，開口前面是哪一邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Away from the wall, toward the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈweɪ frʌm ðə wɔl təˈwɔrd ðə rum/
dialogue.zh: 離牆那一邊，對著房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the manual, the steps are upside down.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə ˈmænjuəl ðə stɛps ɑr ˈʌpsaɪd daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 把說明書轉個方向，步驟都倒著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There, now the arrows make sense.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr naʊ ði ˈæroʊz meɪk sɛns/
dialogue.zh: 好了，現在箭頭看得通了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the diagram use numbers and letters?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ði ˈdaɪəˌɡræm juz ˈnʌmbərz ænd ˈlɛtərz/
dialogue.zh: 這張圖同時用了數字和字母嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Letters for panels, numbers for screws.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛtərz fɔr ˈpænəlz ˈnʌmbərz fɔr skrʊz/
dialogue.zh: 字母代表板子，數字代表螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So B seven means panel B, screw seven?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ bi ˈsɛvən minz ˈpænəl bi skrʊ ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 那B七就是B板配七號螺絲？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, that saved us a guess.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðæt seɪvd ʌs ə ɡɛs/
dialogue.zh: 一點就通，我們不用亂猜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Guessing wastes an hour, usually.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɛsɪŋ weɪstz ən ˈaʊər ˈjuʒəwəli/
dialogue.zh: 亂猜通常會耗掉一個鐘頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We already wasted twenty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɔlˈrɛdi ˈweɪstəd ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnəts/
dialogue.zh: 我們已經浪費二十分鐘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty minutes looking at one picture.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts ˈlʊkɪŋ æt wʌn ˈpɪktʃər/
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘只盯著一張圖看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Worth it, now we know step five.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrθ ɪt naʊ wi noʊ stɛp faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 值得，現在我們懂第五步了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Step five adds the middle shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp faɪv ædz ðə ˈmɪdəl ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 第五步是把中間那層放上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Middle first, then the top two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪdəl fɜrst ðɛn ðə tɑp tu/
dialogue.zh: 先中間，再上面那兩層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a picture of the finished shelf?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈpɪktʃər əv ðə ˈfɪnɪʃt ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 有沒有裝好之後的書架圖？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, small, in the top right corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs smɔl ɪn ðə tɑp raɪt ˈkɔrnər/
dialogue.zh: 有，小小的，在右上角。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five levels, plus a bottom base.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈlɛvəlz plʌs ə ˈbɑtəm beɪs/
dialogue.zh: 五層，再加一個底座。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The base holds the whole weight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə beɪs hoʊldz ðə hoʊl weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 底座要撐全部的重量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This shelf is wide but not deep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ʃɛlf ɪz waɪd bʌt nɑt dip/
dialogue.zh: 這塊層板很寬但是不深。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deep boards take more wall space.
dialogue.phonetic: /dip bɔrdz teɪk mɔr wɔl speɪs/
dialogue.zh: 深的板子比較佔牆邊的空間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you find the video for this model?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju faɪnd ðə ˈvɪdioʊ fɔr ðɪs ˈmɑdəl/
dialogue.zh: 你找得到這個型號的組裝影片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The shop page has a short one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ʃɑp peɪʤ hæz ə ʃɔrt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 商店網頁上有一段很短的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watch the video with sound off?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑtʃ ðə ˈvɪdioʊ wɪð saʊnd ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 要看影片但是把聲音關掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it off, the hands say enough.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt ɔf ðə hændz seɪ ɪˈnʌf/
dialogue.zh: 關掉吧，看他的手就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pause there, he used the hex key.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɔz ðɛr hi ˈjuzd ðə hɛks ki/
dialogue.zh: 暫停那裡，他剛用了六角扳手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our hex key is in the big bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊr hɛks ki ɪz ɪn ðə bɪɡ bæɡ/
dialogue.zh: 我們的六角扳手在那個大袋子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which step uses the key, do you see?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ stɛp ˈjuzɪz ðə ki du ju si/
dialogue.zh: 哪一步要用扳手，你看到了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step eight, but we are only at five.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp eɪt bʌt wi ɑr ˈoʊnli æt faɪv/
dialogue.zh: 第八步，可是我們才做到第五步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Follow the manual, do not skip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɑloʊ ðə ˈmænjuəl du nɑt skɪp/
dialogue.zh: 跟著說明書走，不要跳步驟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Skip nothing, I wrote step six down.
dialogue.phonetic: /skɪp ˈnʌθɪŋ aɪ roʊt stɛp sɪks daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 一步都沒跳，我把第六步記下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why write it on your hand?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ raɪt ɪt ɑn jɔr hænd/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼要寫在自己的手背上？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The paper tore right at step six.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpeɪpər tɔr raɪt æt stɛp sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 因為那張紙剛好從第六步那裡破了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tape the torn paper back together.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪp ðə tɔrn ˈpeɪpər bæk təˈɡɛðər/
dialogue.zh: 用膠帶把破掉的紙黏回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two strips, one at each side.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu strɪps wʌn æt itʃ saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 貼兩條，每一面各一條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I can read both arrows.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ kæn rid boʊθ ˈæroʊz/
dialogue.zh: 現在兩個箭頭都看得清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Arrow down for the shelf, left for the peg.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæroʊ daʊn fɔr ðə ʃɛlf lɛft fɔr ðə pɛɡ/
dialogue.zh: 向下的箭頭是層板，向左的是木釘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Left for the peg, that is new.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft fɔr ðə pɛɡ ðæt ɪz nju/
dialogue.zh: 木釘要往左，這是剛才沒看到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good catch, we had it wrong.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd kætʃ wi hæd ɪt rɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 看得好，我們原本弄錯了方向。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wrong how, the direction or the hole?
dialogue.phonetic: /rɔŋ haʊ ðə dəˈrɛkʃən ɔr ðə hoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 錯在哪裡，是方向還是孔位？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The direction, the hole is right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dəˈrɛkʃən ðə hoʊl ɪz raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是方向錯了，孔位是對的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us start again from step one.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs stɑrt əˈɡɛn frʌm stɛp wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 我們從第一步重新開始吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with the A panel on the blanket.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt wɪð ðə eɪ ˈpænəl ɑn ðə ˈblæŋkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 先把A板放在毯子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One page turned, we are ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn peɪʤ tɜrnd wi ɑr ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 頁翻好了，我們準備要開始了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ready? Then hold still, I lift B.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛdi ðɛn hoʊld stɪl aɪ lɪft bi/
dialogue.zh: 準備好了？那你扶著，我來搬B板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pegs are out, so take your time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɛɡz ɑr aʊt soʊ teɪk jɔr taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 木釘還沒插，所以你要慢慢搬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will set B down again, slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl sɛt bi daʊn əˈɡɛn ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 我再把B板放回地上，慢慢放。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need a screwdriver for step six.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi nid ə ˈskrʊˌdaɪvər fɔr stɛp sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 第六步需要一支螺絲起子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The box only came with the hex key.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɑks ˈoʊnli keɪm wɪð ðə hɛks ki/
dialogue.zh: 紙箱裡只附了六角扳手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check the toolbox under the bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə ˈtʊlˌboʊks ˈʌndər ðə bɛd/
dialogue.zh: 看看床底下那個工具箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I pulled it out, it is empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ pʊld ɪt aʊt ɪt ɪz ˈɛmpti/
dialogue.zh: 我把它拖出來了，裡面是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Empty? We had two screwdrivers there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmpti wi hæd tu ˈskrʊˌdaɪvərz ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 空的？我們本來在那裡有兩支。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You lent one to Lin last month.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lɛnt wʌn tu lɪn læst mʌnθ/
dialogue.zh: 你上個月借給鈴一支了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lin? I will ask her tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪn aɪ wɪl æsk hɜr təˈmɑroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 鈴？我明天再向她要好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow is late, we need it now.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ ɪz leɪt wi nid ɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 明天太慢，我們現在就需要它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try the kitchen drawer by the sink.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə ˈkɪtʃən drɔr baɪ ðə sɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 先開水槽旁邊那個廚房抽屜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drawers full of tape and old keys.
dialogue.phonetic: /drɔərz fʊl əv teɪp ænd oʊld kiz/
dialogue.zh: 抽屜裡全是膠帶和舊鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any screwdriver under that messy pile?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˈskrʊˌdaɪvər ˈʌndər ðæt ˈmɛsi paɪl/
dialogue.zh: 那堆亂東西下面有螺絲起子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, only a bent flat metal bar.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈoʊnli ə bɛnt flæt ˈmɛtəl bɑr/
dialogue.zh: 沒有，只有一根彎掉的扁鐵條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A bent bar is not a tool.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɛnt bɑr ɪz nɑt ə tuːl/
dialogue.zh: 彎掉的鐵條並不算工具。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But the long one may fit a screw.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðə lɔŋ wʌn meɪ fɪt ə skrʊ/
dialogue.zh: 但那根長的也許應付得了螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not use metal on metal screws.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt juz ˈmɛtəl ɑn ˈmɛtəl skrʊz/
dialogue.zh: 別拿鐵條去弄金屬螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, I will look in the balcony box.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn aɪ wɪl lʊk ɪn ðə ˈbælkəni bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 好吧，我去陽台那個箱子找。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That outdoor box is full of rust.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈaʊtˌdɔr bɑks ɪz fʊl əv rʌst/
dialogue.zh: 那個戶外置物箱都是鐵鏽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rusty tools still turn a screw.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrʌsti tuːlz stɪl tɜrn ə skrʊ/
dialogue.zh: 生鏽的工具還是轉得動螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, this red handle is a driver!
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk ðɪs rɛd ˈhændəl ɪz ə ˈdraɪvər/
dialogue.zh: 你看，這個紅色手柄的是起子！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is it cross head or flat head?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt krɔs hɛd ɔr flæt hɛd/
dialogue.zh: 它是十字頭還是一字頭？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The tip has a small cross shape.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tɪp hæz ə smɔl krɔs ʃeɪp/
dialogue.zh: 它的頭是一個小小的十字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it fits our silver screws.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt fɪts aʊr ˈsɪlvər skrʊz/
dialogue.zh: 那剛好合我們那些銀色螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try it on the loose screw here.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ɪt ɑn ðə lus skrʊ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 先鎖鎖看這裡這顆鬆的螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It turns, but my hand slips off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt tɜrnz bʌt maɪ hænd slɪps ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 有在轉，但我的手一直滑開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wipe the handle, it is oily.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ðə ˈhændəl ɪt ɪz ˈɔɪli/
dialogue.zh: 擦一下手柄，上面有油。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old oil, from that rusty box.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld ɔɪl frʌm ðæt ˈrʌsti bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 是舊的油，來自那個生鏽的箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now my grip feels much better.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ maɪ ɡrɪp filz mʌtʃ ˈbɛtər/
dialogue.zh: 現在我握起來穩多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now turn slowly, keep it straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ tɜrn ˈsloʊli kip ɪt streɪt/
dialogue.zh: 現在慢慢轉，起子要保持垂直。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we also need the electric driver?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi ˈɔlsoʊ nid ði ɪˈlɛktrɪk ˈdraɪvər/
dialogue.zh: 我們還需要電動起子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It would save our wrists, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wʊd seɪv aʊr rɪsts jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 那可以救我們的手腕，要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Its batteries died last spring, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts bæˈtɛriz daɪd læst sprɪŋ aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我想它的電池去年春天就沒電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two new batteries might bring it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu nju bæˈtɛriz maɪt brɪŋ ɪt bæk/
dialogue.zh: 兩顆新電池說不定能救回來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The battery pack is in the closet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbætəri pæk ɪz ɪn ðə ˈklɑzət/
dialogue.zh: 那一包電池收在衣櫃裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring two, check the size first.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ tu tʃɛk ðə saɪz fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 拿兩顆來，先對一下尺寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Size small, the same as the remote.
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪz smɔl ðə seɪm æz ði rɪˈmoʊt/
dialogue.zh: 小號的，跟遙控器裡的一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, those work in the driver too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðoʊz wɜrk ɪn ðə ˈdraɪvər tu/
dialogue.zh: 好，那種規格起子也能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did we put the driver bits?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr dɪd wi pʊt ðə ˈdraɪvər bɪts/
dialogue.zh: 起子的替換頭我們收在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small bag, with the hex key.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl bæɡ wɪð ðə hɛks ki/
dialogue.zh: 在一個小袋子裡，跟扳手一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This bag has only one wide bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs bæɡ hæz ˈoʊnli wʌn waɪd bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 這個袋子裡只有一個寬頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use it for the bottom screws only.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ɪt fɔr ðə ˈbɑtəm skrʊz ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 下面那幾顆螺絲就先用它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hand me the long one, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /hænd mi ðə lɔŋ wʌn pliz/
dialogue.zh: 請把長的那一支遞給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The silver long one or the black?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈsɪlvər lɔŋ wʌn ɔr ðə blæk/
dialogue.zh: 銀色那支長的，還是黑色的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Black, it grips the screw better.
dialogue.phonetic: /blæk ɪt ɡrɪps ðə skrʊ ˈbɛtər/
dialogue.zh: 黑色的，它咬螺絲咬得較穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, and take this soft cloth too.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ænd teɪk ðɪs sɔft klɔθ tu/
dialogue.zh: 給你，這條軟布也一併拿去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cloth for what? My hands are clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɔθ fɔr wʌt maɪ hændz ɑr klin/
dialogue.zh: 布要做什麼？我兩手很乾淨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For the floor, so nothing scratches.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ðə flɔr soʊ ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈskrætʃəz/
dialogue.zh: 墊在地上的，這樣才不會刮傷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My knees hurt on this hard floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ niz hɜrt ɑn ðɪs hɑrd flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 在硬地板上跪久了膝蓋很痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fold the blanket twice, sit there.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊld ðə ˈblæŋkɪt twaɪs sɪt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 毯子摺兩下，坐在那上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That cushion helps, thanks for thinking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈkʊʃən hɛlps θæŋks fɔr ˈθɪŋkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 那個軟墊有用，謝謝你想到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I also got the small reading lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ ɡɑt ðə smɔl ˈridɪŋ læmp/
dialogue.zh: 我也把那一盞小台燈拿來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lamp lights the deep holes well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læmp laɪts ðə dip hoʊlz wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 台燈照比較深的孔很好用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move it near the panel edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ɪt nɪr ðə ˈpænəl ɛʤ/
dialogue.zh: 把它挪近板子的邊緣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hold the flashlight for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju hoʊld ðə ˈflæʃˌlaɪt fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 可以幫我拿手電筒照一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, aim it at that far hole.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs em ɪt æt ðæt fɑr hoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 好，對著最裡面那個孔照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The light shows dust inside the hole.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪt ʃoʊz dʌst ɪnˈsaɪd ðə hoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 用燈光一照，就看見孔裡有灰塵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Blow it out, then wipe the tip.
dialogue.phonetic: /bloʊ ɪt aʊt ðɛn waɪp ðə tɪp/
dialogue.zh: 先把灰吹出來，再擦一下起子頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I blew, but something is still stuck.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ blu bʌt ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪz stɪl stʌk/
dialogue.zh: 我吹了，但還有東西卡在那裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the thin wire to dig it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ðə θɪn waɪr tu dɪɡ ɪt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 用那根細鐵絲把它挑出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we keep the thin wire?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du wi kip ðə θɪn waɪr/
dialogue.zh: 那根細鐵絲我們收在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: In the balcony box, near the pliers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ðə ˈbælkəni bɑks nɪr ðə ˈplɪərz/
dialogue.zh: 在陽台那個箱子裡，鉗子的旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pliers can hold a short screw.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈplɪərz kæn hoʊld ə ʃɔrt skrʊ/
dialogue.zh: 鉗子可以夾住短短的螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, pliers mark the metal head.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl ˈplɪərz mɑrk ðə ˈmɛtəl hɛd/
dialogue.zh: 小心，鉗子會在螺絲頭留痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The manual says no pliers on screws.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmænjuəl sɛz noʊ ˈplɪərz ɑn skrʊz/
dialogue.zh: 說明書上寫，螺絲不要用鉗子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then only the cross driver, understood.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈoʊnli ðə krɔs ˈdraɪvər ˌʌndərsˈtʊd/
dialogue.zh: 那就只用十字起子，我知道了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you hear that clicking sound?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hɪr ðæt ˈklɪkɪŋ saʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 你有聽到那個咔噠聲嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is your screw slipping in the hole.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz jɔr skrʊ ˈslɪpɪŋ ɪn ðə hoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 那是你的螺絲在孔裡打滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Slipping? Then I stop right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈslɪpɪŋ ðɛn aɪ stɑp raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 打滑？那我現在就停手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull the screw out, look at it.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ðə skrʊ aʊt lʊk æt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 把螺絲退出來，檢查一下它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The threads are a little worn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə θrɛdz ɑr ə ˈlɪtəl wɔrn/
dialogue.zh: 螺紋有一點磨損了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swap it with the spare from bag one.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɑp ɪt wɪð ðə spɛr frʌm bæɡ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 拿一號袋那顆備用的換掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, the spare fits the hole now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðə spɛr fɪts ðə hoʊl naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，備用螺絲現在剛合那個孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it slow, feel the thread catch.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt sloʊ fil ðə θrɛd kætʃ/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢轉，感覺螺紋有沒有咬住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel it, it bites once.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil ɪt ɪt baɪts wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 我有感覺，它咬進了一下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then keep turning until it stops.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn kip ˈtɜrnɪŋ ʌnˈtɪl ɪt stɑps/
dialogue.zh: 那就繼續轉，轉到它卡住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How tight should this screw be?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ taɪt ʃʊd ðɪs skrʊ bi/
dialogue.zh: 這一顆螺絲要鎖到多緊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tight, but do not crush the board.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪt bʌt du nɑt krʌʃ ðə bɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 緊就好，但是彆壓壞板子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The driver slips when I push hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdraɪvər slɪps wɛn aɪ pʊʃ hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 我一用力往下壓，起子就滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Less push, more steady turning.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛs pʊʃ mɔr ˈstɛdi ˈtɜrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 少用推力，多一點穩定的旋轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Steady turning, that is my new rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɛdi ˈtɜrnɪŋ ðæt ɪz maɪ nju rul/
dialogue.zh: 穩穩地轉，這是我新定的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write that rule on the manual page.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ðæt rul ɑn ðə ˈmænjuəl peɪʤ/
dialogue.zh: 把這句話寫在說明書那一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do we use the hex key?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du wi juz ðə hɛks ki/
dialogue.zh: 六角扳手要用在什麼地方？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the feet, to set the height.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə fit tu sɛt ðə haɪt/
dialogue.zh: 用在腳墊上，調整高度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the foot clockwise to lower it?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə fʊt ˈklɑkˌwaɪz tə ˈloʊər ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 順時針轉腳墊就可以調低嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clockwise up, the other way down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklɑkˌwaɪz ʌp ði ˈʌðər weɪ daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 順時針是升高，反過來是降低。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My right hand is already tired.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ raɪt hænd ɪz ɔlˈrɛdi ˈtaɪərd/
dialogue.zh: 我的右手已經有點累了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Switch hands, rest the wrist a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɪtʃ hændz rɛst ðə rɪst ə bɪt/
dialogue.zh: 換一隻手，讓手腕休息一會。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our screw bag has a hole in it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊr skrʊ bæɡ hæz ə hoʊl ɪn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 裝螺絲的袋子破了一個洞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move the bits to the yellow cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ðə bɪts tu ðə ˈjɛloʊ kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 把起子頭全部移到黃色杯子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lin still has one of our drivers.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɪn stɪl hæz wʌn ɑv ˈɑər ˈdraɪvərz/
dialogue.zh: 鈴那兒還留著我們的一支起子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She is home, I heard her music.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɪz hoʊm aɪ hɜrd hɜr ˈmjuzɪk/
dialogue.zh: 她在家裡，我聽到她的音樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will text her right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl tɛkst hɜr raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在馬上傳訊息給她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask for the level too, if she owns one.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk fɔr ðə ˈlɛvəl tu ɪf ʃi oʊnz wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 順便問她借水平尺，如果她有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A level? For a bookshelf, really?
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɛvəl fɔr ə ˈbʊkˌʃɛlf ˈrɪli/
dialogue.zh: 水平尺？書架真的需要嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, so the shelves are not tilted.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs soʊ ðə ʃɛlvz ɑr nɑt ˈtɪltəd/
dialogue.zh: 要，不然層板會慢慢歪掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tilted shelves make books slide off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɪltəd ʃɛlvz meɪk bʊks slaɪd ɔf/
dialogue.zh: 歪斜的層板會讓書滑下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is why we check it twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz waɪ wi tʃɛk ɪt twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 所以我們要檢查兩次才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So, hex key and one cross driver.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ hɛks ki ænd wʌn krɔs ˈdraɪvər/
dialogue.zh: 所以，一把六角扳手加一支十字起子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two tools, and one level to borrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu tuːlz ænd wʌn ˈlɛvəl tə ˈbɑroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 兩樣工具，還有一把水平尺要借。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Borrow it later, the shelf comes first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɑroʊ ɪt ˈleɪtər ðə ʃɛlf kʌmz fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 之後再借，先把書架裝好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let us find the first screw hole.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn lɛt ʌs faɪnd ðə fɜrst skrʊ hoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就來找第一個螺絲孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This screw stops halfway down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs skrʊ stɑps ˈhæfˌweɪ daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 這顆螺絲鎖到一半就停住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not push it, back it out.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt pʊʃ ɪt bæk ɪt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 彆硬推，先把它退出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It came out, but the hole feels shallow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt keɪm aʊt bʌt ðə hoʊl filz ˈʃæloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 退出來了，但那個孔感覺很淺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shallow means the peg is blocking it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃæloʊ minz ðə pɛɡ ɪz bloˈkɪŋ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 淺就代表裡面的木釘擋住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The peg sits too deep in there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɛɡ sɪts tu dip ɪn ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 那根木釘插得太深了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pull it up with the pliers, gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊl ɪt ʌp wɪð ðə ˈplɪərz ˈʤɛntli/
dialogue.zh: 用鉗子輕輕把它夾高一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the peg is even with the wood.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə pɛɡ ɪz ˈivɪn wɪð ðə wʊd/
dialogue.zh: 現在木釘和板面齊平了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the screw again, slow and straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə skrʊ əˈɡɛn sloʊ ænd streɪt/
dialogue.zh: 再試一次那顆螺絲，要慢要直。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Same stop, at the very same place.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪm stɑp æt ðə ˈvɛri seɪm pleɪs/
dialogue.zh: 又卡住了，在同一個位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the hole is off from the peg.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə hoʊl ɪz ɔf frʌm ðə pɛɡ/
dialogue.zh: 那就是孔和木釘沒有對好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Off by how much, a little?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔf baɪ haʊ mʌtʃ ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 差了多少，是一點點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe two millimeters, not more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi tu ˈmɪləˌmɪtərz nɑt mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 也許兩毫米，不會再多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two millimeters is a real problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmɪləˌmɪtərz ɪz ə ril ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 兩毫米也是一個真的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, the screw will never pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ðə skrʊ wɪl ˈnɛvər pæs/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，那顆螺絲永遠進不去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the panel bent or is it flat?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈpænəl bɛnt ɔr ɪz ɪt flæt/
dialogue.zh: 是板子彎了，還是它是平的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Flat on the table, but one edge lifts.
dialogue.phonetic: /flæt ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl bʌt wʌn ɛʤ lɪfts/
dialogue.zh: 在桌上是平的，但一個角翹起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A lifted edge moves every hole.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪftɪd ɛʤ muvz ˈɛvri hoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 翹起的邊會讓每一個孔都偏掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press it down while I turn this.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ɪt daʊn waɪl aɪ tɜrn ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 你壓住它，我來轉這顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I press here with my whole palm.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ prɛs hɪr wɪð maɪ hoʊl pɑm/
dialogue.zh: 我用我整個手掌壓住這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, the screw moves a little now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðə skrʊ muvz ə ˈlɪtəl naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 好，螺絲現在有一點在動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only a little? It needs to pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ə ˈlɪtəl ɪt nidz tə pæs/
dialogue.zh: 只動一點？它要完全進去的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn with patience, not with anger.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn wɪð ˈpeɪʃəns nɑt wɪð ˈæŋɡər/
dialogue.zh: 要用耐心轉，不能用氣的轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anger helps nothing, you are right.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæŋɡər hɛlps ˈnʌθɪŋ ju ɑr raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 生氣沒有用，你說得對。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me try the driver for once.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi traɪ ðə ˈdraɪvər fɔr wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 讓我先自己試一次起子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, that hole has no wood left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl ðæt hoʊl hæz noʊ wʊd lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 小心，那個孔裡幾乎沒木頭了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the screw will spin and spin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə skrʊ wɪl spɪn ænd spɪn/
dialogue.zh: 那樣螺絲就會在那裡空轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Spin means the thread has no grip.
dialogue.phonetic: /spɪn minz ðə θrɛd hæz noʊ ɡrɪp/
dialogue.zh: 空轉代表螺紋完全咬不住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We need a plug or a longer screw.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi nid ə plʌɡ ɔr ə ˈlɔŋɡər skrʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我們需要木塞或是更長的螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bag has no longer screws, sadly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæɡ hæz noʊ ˈlɔŋɡər skrʊz ˈsædli/
dialogue.zh: 可惜袋子裡沒有更長的螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we fix the hole itself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi fɪks ðə hoʊl ɪtˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就直接修那個孔本身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How? With the wooden pegs we have?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ wɪð ðə ˈwʊdən pɛɡz wi hæv/
dialogue.zh: 怎麼修，用我們現有的木釘嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, break a peg in two parts.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs breɪk ə pɛɡ ɪn tu pɑrts/
dialogue.zh: 對，把一根木釘掰成兩段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Break it? That feels like damage.
dialogue.phonetic: /breɪk ɪt ðæt filz laɪk ˈdæmɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 掰斷？這感覺實在像破壞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fills the loose hole, watch me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt fɪlz ðə lus hoʊl wɑtʃ mi/
dialogue.zh: 它會填滿鬆掉的孔，你看我做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You push the pieces in with a thumb.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju pʊʃ ðə ˈpisəz ɪn wɪð ə θʌm/
dialogue.zh: 你用拇指把碎木片壓進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two pieces, and the hole feels full.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈpisəz ænd ðə hoʊl filz fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 放了兩段，那個孔就感覺飽了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Screw in now? I will try it.
dialogue.phonetic: /skrʊ ɪn naʊ aɪ wɪl traɪ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 現在鎖螺絲嗎？我來試試看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try, and tell me if it grips.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ænd tɛl mi ɪf ɪt ɡrɪps/
dialogue.zh: 試吧，告訴我它咬不咬得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It grips! Half a turn, then stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɡrɪps hæf ə tɜrn ðɛn stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 咬住了！轉半圈就先停一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half a turn means we are close.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ə tɜrn minz wi ɑr kloʊs/
dialogue.zh: 轉半圈代表我們已經接近了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close is not done, keep going.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊz ɪz nɑt dʌn kip ˈɡoʊɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 接近還沒有完成，繼續轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am going, my wrist is working.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈɡoʊɪŋ maɪ rɪst ɪz ˈwɜrkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我在轉了，我的手腕正在使力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stop if the board starts to crack.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp ɪf ðə bɔrd stɑrts tə kræk/
dialogue.zh: 板子要是開始裂開就停。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hear nothing, the board is safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɪr ˈnʌθɪŋ ðə bɔrd ɪz seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 我什麼聲音都沒聽到，板子安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Safe is good news for tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪf ɪz ɡʊd nuz fɔr təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 安全對今晚來說是個好消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now line the next panel up.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ laɪn ðə nɛkst ˈpænəl ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 現在把下一塊側板對好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Line up means each hole matches a hole.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪn ʌp minz itʃ hoʊl ˈmætʃɪz ə hoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 對好就是一個孔對上一個孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, I hold the two edges near.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt aɪ hoʊld ðə tu ˈɛdʒɪz nɪr/
dialogue.zh: 對，我先讓兩條邊靠近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still a gap, about your finger wide.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl ə ɡæp əˈbaʊt jɔr ˈfɪŋɡər waɪd/
dialogue.zh: 中間還有縫，大約一指寬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Push them with your knee, hold the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ðɛm wɪð jɔr ni hoʊld ðə ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 用膝蓋頂住，另一手抓著層板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Together now, the holes are aligned.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈɡɛðər naʊ ðə hoʊlz ɑr əˈlaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 現在兩塊合起來了，孔都對準。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aligned? Then slide the long screw in.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlaɪnd ðɛn slaɪd ðə lɔŋ skrʊ ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 對準了？那就把長螺絲穿進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It slides, wow, it goes all the way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt slaɪdz waʊ ɪt ɡoʊz ɔl ðə weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 進去了，哇，一路鎖到底。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Turn it till the head sits flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ɪt tɪl ðə hɛd sɪts flæt/
dialogue.zh: 轉到螺絲頭平貼在板面上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flat head, check, one of four done.
dialogue.phonetic: /flæt hɛd tʃɛk wʌn əv fɔr dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 頭平了，確認過，四顆之一完成。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three more, same hole numbers, easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri mɔr seɪm hoʊl ˈnʌmbərz ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 還有三顆，同樣的孔號，不難。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hole five feels blocked at the bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊl faɪv filz blɑkt æt ðə ˈbɑtəm/
dialogue.zh: 五號孔感覺底部被堵住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A plug of dust sits in there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə plʌɡ əv dʌst sɪts ɪn ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 有一團灰塵塞在孔的深處。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need to pull it out, not blow it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid tə pʊl ɪt aʊt nɑt bloʊ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我得把髒東西勾出來，不能只用吹的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Scrape it with the tip of a screw.
dialogue.phonetic: /skreɪp ɪt wɪð ðə tɪp əv ə skrʊ/
dialogue.zh: 用一顆螺絲的尖端去刮出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Out came a lump of sawdust.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt keɪm ə lʌmp əv ˈsɔˌdʌst/
dialogue.zh: 掉出來一團木屑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sawdust from the factory, still there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɔˌdʌst frʌm ðə ˈfæktəri stɪl ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 是工廠殘留在孔裡的木屑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the screw goes to the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə skrʊ ɡoʊz tə ði ɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 現在這顆螺絲可以鎖到最底了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: End to end, that is a clean hole.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɛnd tə ɛnd ðæt ɪz ə klin hoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 從頭到底，這才是一個乾淨的孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hole six is smaller than the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊl sɪks ɪz ˈsmɔlər ðæn ði rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 六號孔比其他孔都還要小。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then that screw will never enter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðæt skrʊ wɪl ˈnɛvər ˈɛntər/
dialogue.zh: 那一顆螺絲就永遠進不去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we make the hole bigger?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi meɪk ðə hoʊl ˈbɪɡər/
dialogue.zh: 我們該把這個孔弄大一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only with the thin drill bit, once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wɪð ðə θɪn drɪl bɪt wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 只能用那支細鑽頭，轉一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Once, gently, and I stopped there.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌns ˈʤɛntli ænd aɪ stɑpt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 就一次，輕輕地，到那裡我就停了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now try it, the screw should pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ traɪ ɪt ðə skrʊ ʃʊd pæs/
dialogue.zh: 現在試試看，螺絲應該進得去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It passes, but the wood is soft.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈpæsɪz bʌt ðə wʊd ɪz sɔft/
dialogue.zh: 進去了，但那邊的木頭變軟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not tighten too much, stop there.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt ˈtaɪtən tu mʌtʃ stɑp ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 彆鎖過頭，剛剛好就停下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too much and the hole will widen.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu mʌtʃ ænd ðə hoʊl wɪl ˈwaɪdn/
dialogue.zh: 鎖太多的話，孔會被撐得更寬。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we stop, and we check again.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi stɑp ænd wi tʃɛk əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 所以我們停下來，再檢查一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check with your finger, not the driver.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk wɪð jɔr ˈfɪŋɡər nɑt ðə ˈdraɪvər/
dialogue.zh: 用手指檢查就好，別用起子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I feel it flat, no raised edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil ɪt flæt noʊ reɪzd ɛʤ/
dialogue.zh: 我摸起來是平的，沒有地方凸起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No raised edge means we can move on.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ reɪzd ɛʤ minz wi kæn muv ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 沒有凸起就代表我們可以往下做。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move on to hole seven, the last.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ɑn tu hoʊl ˈsɛvən ðə læst/
dialogue.zh: 接著做七號孔，最後一個孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hole seven is on the wrong side.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊl ˈsɛvən ɪz ɑn ðə rɔŋ saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 七號孔卻在錯誤的那一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wrong side? Then the panel is flipped.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɔŋ saɪd ðɛn ðə ˈpænəl ɪz flɪpt/
dialogue.zh: 錯的一邊？那這板子是拿錯面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flipped? But we have not screwed it.
dialogue.phonetic: /flɪpt bʌt wi hæv nɑt skrʊd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 拿錯面？但我們還沒鎖它啊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at the small print, panel B.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə smɔl prɪnt ˈpænəl bi/
dialogue.zh: 看那行小字，這一塊是B板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is B, and we need A here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz bi ænd wi nid eɪ hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 這是B板，而我們這裡需要A板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swap them now, before any screws.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɑp ðɛm naʊ bɪˈfɔr ˈɛni skrʊz/
dialogue.zh: 趁還沒鎖螺絲，現在交換它們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swapped, and the holes match again.
dialogue.phonetic: /swɑpt ænd ðə hoʊlz mætʃ əˈɡɛn/
dialogue.zh: 換好了，孔又全部對得上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: See, eight holes, exactly eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /si eɪt hoʊlz ɪɡˈzæktli eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 看到了嗎，八個孔，正好八個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight here, but the list says nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt hɪr bʌt ðə lɪst sɛz naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 這裡只有八個，清單卻寫九個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One hole is covered by the film.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn hoʊl ɪz ˈkʌvərd baɪ ðə fɪlm/
dialogue.zh: 有一個孔還被保護膜蓋在底下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Peel it, there was a hidden hole.
dialogue.phonetic: /pil ɪt ðɛr wʌz ə ˈhɪdn hoʊl/
dialogue.zh: 撕開看看，那裡藏了一個孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nine, the count matches the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪn ðə kaʊnt ˈmætʃəz ðə lɪst/
dialogue.zh: 九個了，數量和清單一致了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Matches the list, that feels great.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmætʃəz ðə lɪst ðæt filz ɡreɪt/
dialogue.zh: 跟清單一致了，感覺真的很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, but my hands still shake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt bʌt maɪ hændz stɪl ʃek/
dialogue.zh: 很好，可是我的手還在抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shake from the work or the worry?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃek frʌm ðə wɜrk ɔr ðə ˈwɜri/
dialogue.zh: 抖是因為累，還是因為擔心？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both, and the sun is going down.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ænd ðə sʌn ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 兩者都有，而且太陽快要下山了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Going down means we need more light.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡoʊɪŋ daʊn minz wi nid mɔr laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 太陽下山代表我們要多一點光。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get the tall lamp from the bedroom.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛt ðə tɔl læmp frʌm ðə ˈbɛdˌrum/
dialogue.zh: 去臥室把那盞立燈搬過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Lamp here, now every hole shows.
dialogue.phonetic: /læmp hɪr naʊ ˈɛvri hoʊl ʃoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 燈放這裡，現在每一個孔都看得見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every hole, and every small number.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri hoʊl ænd ˈɛvri smɔl ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 每一個孔，還有每一個小小的編號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Numbers read, holes matched, almost.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌmbərz rɛd hoʊlz mætʃt ˈɔlmoʊst/
dialogue.zh: 編號讀完、孔也對了，差不多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Almost, but the top is not on yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst bʌt ðə tɑp ɪz nɑt ɑn jɛt/
dialogue.zh: 快了，不過最上面那層還沒放上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This panel is taller than me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈpænəl ɪz ˈtɔlər ðæn mi/
dialogue.zh: 這塊側板比我還高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it needs a second pair of hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt nidz ə ˈsɛkənd pɛr ʌv hændz/
dialogue.zh: 那就需要第二雙手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whose hands do I borrow now?
dialogue.phonetic: /huz hændz du aɪ ˈbɑroʊ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我現在該去借誰的手？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Call Sam, he lives upstairs.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl sæm hi lɪvz ˌʌpˈstɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 叫山姆，他就住樓上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He is busy with his own box.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɪz ˈbɪzi wɪð hɪz oʊn bɑks/
dialogue.zh: 他正忙著拆他自己的箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then knock anyway, he owes you one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn nɑk ˈɛniˌweɪ hɪ ˈoʊz ju wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 那也照敲，他欠你一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I rang the bell twice already.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ræŋ ðə bɛl twaɪs ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 我已經按過兩次電鈴了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is home, his light is on.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪ ɪz hoʊm hɪz laɪt ɪz ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 他在家，他的燈亮著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The door opens, he looks confused.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə dɔr ˈoʊpənz hi lʊks kənˈfjuzd/
dialogue.zh: 門開了，他一臉困惑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Confused is fine, just wave him along.
dialogue.phonetic: /kənˈfjuzd ɪz faɪn dʒʌst weɪv hɪm əˈlɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 困惑沒關係，揮揮手叫他跟著來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hold one tall panel?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju hoʊld wʌn tɔl ˈpænəl/
dialogue.zh: 你能扶住一塊高側板嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which one, the left or the right?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ wʌn ðə lɛft ɔr ðə raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哪一塊，左邊還是右邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The left side, it stands two meters.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə lɛft saɪd ɪt stændz tu ˈmitərz/
dialogue.zh: 左邊那塊，它有兩公尺高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two meters is a serious side panel.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈmitərz ɪz ə ˈsɪriəs saɪd ˈpænəl/
dialogue.zh: 兩公尺高的側板可不是開玩笑的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It falls the moment I let go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt fɔlz ðə ˈmoʊmənt aɪ lɛt goʊ/
dialogue.zh: 我一鬆手它就倒下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So hold it low against the base.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ hoʊld ɪt loʊ əˈgɛnst ðə beɪs/
dialogue.zh: 所以把它低低抵住底座。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Brace your knee under the board.
dialogue.phonetic: /breɪs jʊr ni ˈʌndər ðə bɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 用膝蓋在板材下面頂住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this, tilting back a little?
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪk ðɪs ˈtɪlɪŋ bæk ə ˈlɪtəl/
dialogue.zh: 像這樣，往後傾一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that keeps it from tipping.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðæt kips ɪt frʌm ˈtɪpɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 對，這樣就不會翻倒。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My hands are going numb already.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hændz ɑr ˈgoʊɪŋ nʌm ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 我的手已經快麻了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Count to three, then swap hands.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt tu θri ðɛn swɑp hændz/
dialogue.zh: 數到三，然後換手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One, two, three, got it, take it.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tu θri gɑt ɪt teɪk ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 一、二、三，接住了，給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did it lean while I turned around?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ɪt lin waɪl aɪ tɜrnd əˈraʊnd/
dialogue.zh: 我轉身的時候它歪了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It leaned, straighten it, push gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt lind ˈstreɪtən ɪt pʊʃ ˈdʒɛntli/
dialogue.zh: 歪了一點，扶正，輕輕推。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How straight does it have to be?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ streɪt dʌz ɪt hæv tu bi/
dialogue.zh: 它要多正才算可以？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Straight enough that the top is flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /streɪt ɪˈnʌf ðæt ðə tɑp ɪz flæt/
dialogue.zh: 正到頂面看起來是平的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little to the left, more so.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl tu ðə lɛft mɔr soʊ/
dialogue.zh: 往左一點，再過去一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much more? I cannot see.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ mɔr aɪ ˈkænɑt si/
dialogue.zh: 還要多少？我看不到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stop, that corner touches the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp ðæt ˈkɔrnər ˈtʌtʃəz ðə wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 停，那個角碰到牆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The wall is not part of this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə wɔl ɪz nɑt pɑrt ʌv ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 牆又不是這個架子的一部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold the edge, do not squeeze.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ði ɛdʒ du nɑt skwiz/
dialogue.zh: 扶住邊邊就好，別捏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am holding, my phone is ringing.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈhoʊldɪŋ maɪ foʊn ɪz ˈrɪŋɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我有在扶，我的手機在響。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ignore it, that screw is loose.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɪɡˈnɔr ɪt ðæt skrʊ ɪz lus/
dialogue.zh: 先不理它，那顆螺絲鬆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Loose where, on the top rail?
dialogue.phonetic: /lus wɛr ɑn ðə tɑp reɪl/
dialogue.zh: 鬆在哪裡，上面那根橫檔嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: On the rail, right by your elbow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə reɪl raɪt baɪ jʊr ˈɛloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 就在橫檔上，靠近你的手肘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, elbow slipped, hold on a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri ˈɛloʊ slɪpt hoʊld ɑn ə ˈsɛkənd/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，手肘滑了，等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take your time, the base is stable.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jʊr taɪm ðə beɪs ɪz ˈsteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 慢慢來，底座很穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stable base makes tall panels easier.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsteɪbəl beɪs meɪks tɔl ˈpænəlz ˈiziər/
dialogue.zh: 底座穩，高側板就好對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit on the bottom, add some weight.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt ɑn ðə ˈbɑtəm æd sʌm weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 坐在最下面那層，加點重量。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sitting helps, now it does not shake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪtɪŋ hɛlps naʊ ɪt dʌz nɑt ʃeɪk/
dialogue.zh: 坐上去有差，現在它不搖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your chair works better than a body.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr tʃɛr wɜrks ˈbɛtər ðæn ə ˈbɑdi/
dialogue.zh: 你的椅子比人還好用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The chair weighs more, so it holds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tʃɛr weɪz mɔr soʊ ɪt hoʊldz/
dialogue.zh: 椅子比較重，所以壓得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not sit on the box itself.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt sɪt ɑn ðə bɑks ɪtˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 別直接坐在紙箱上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too late, the cardboard went flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu leɪt ðə ˈkɑrdˌbɔrd wɛnt flæt/
dialogue.zh: 太慢了，紙箱被壓扁了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grab the clamp from my tool bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /græb ðə klæmp frʌm maɪ tul bæg/
dialogue.zh: 去我的工具袋把夾具拿出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The metal one with the red handle?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈmɛtəl wʌn wɪð ðə rɛd ˈhændəl/
dialogue.zh: 紅把手那個金屬的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one, screw it against the side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn skrʊ ɪt əˈgɛnst ðə saɪd/
dialogue.zh: 就那個，鎖在側板外側。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clamped tight, it stands on its own.
dialogue.phonetic: /klæmpt taɪt ɪt stændz ɑn ɪts on/
dialogue.zh: 夾緊了，它自己就站得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See, two hands beat one every time.
dialogue.phonetic: /si tu hændz bit wʌn ˈɛvri taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 看吧，兩隻手永遠比一隻強。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every time, that is a fact.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri taɪm ðæt ɪz ə fækt/
dialogue.zh: 每次都這樣，這是事實。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sam is laughing at us from the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæm ɪz ˈlæfɪŋ æt ʌs frʌm ðə hɔl/
dialogue.zh: 山姆在走廊那裡笑我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Laughing is free help, ask him to stay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlæfɪŋ ɪz fri hɛlp æsk hɪm tə steɪ/
dialogue.zh: 笑也是免費的幫忙，請他留下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask him if he owns a level.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk hɪm ɪf hi oʊnz ə ˈlɛvəl/
dialogue.zh: 問問他有沒有水平尺。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He does, and he brings coffee too.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi dʌz ænd hi brɪŋz ˈkɔfi tu/
dialogue.zh: 他有，而且他還會帶咖啡來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Coffee and a level, perfect morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɔfi ænd ə ˈlɛvəl ˈpɜrfɪkt ˈmɔrnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 咖啡加水平尺，完美的上午。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, if the bubble sits centered.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt ɪf ðə ˈbʌbəl sɪts ˈsɛntərd/
dialogue.zh: 要是氣泡正中間才算完美。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bubble is drifting toward the left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbʌbəl ɪz ˈdrɪftɪŋ təˈwɔrd ðə lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 氣泡正往左邊漂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Left means the floor is not flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛft minz ðə flɔr ɪz nɑt flæt/
dialogue.zh: 偏左代表地板不平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our floor is old, it has bumps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər flɔr ɪz oʊld ɪt hæz bʌmps/
dialogue.zh: 我們地板很舊，有凸起。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bumps explain the whole wobbling problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌmps ɪkˈspleɪn ðə hoʊl ˈwɑbəlɪŋ ˈprɑbləm/
dialogue.zh: 難怪一直在晃，是地板的錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the foot out, then shim with cardboard.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðə fʊt aʊt ðɛn ʃɪm wɪð ˈkɑrdˌbɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 把腳墊往外轉，再用紙板墊一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One fold, two folds, still not level.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn foʊld tu foʊldz stɪl nɑt ˈlɛvəl/
dialogue.zh: 折一層、兩層，還是沒水平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Push the panel, I will read it.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ðə ˈpænəl aɪ wɪl rid ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 你推側板，我來看讀數。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Reading a level is awkward work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈridɪŋ ə ˈlɛvəl ɪz ˈɔkwərd wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 看水平尺實在是一件彆扭的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your friend is very good at this.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr frɛnd ɪz ˈvɛri gʊd æt ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 你的朋友很會扶東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He moved once, now he holds still.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi muvd wʌns naʊ hi hoʊldz stɪl/
dialogue.zh: 他動過一次，現在扶著不動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell him thanks, he earns a snack.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɪm θæŋks hi ɜrnz ə snæk/
dialogue.zh: 跟他說謝謝，他值得點心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snacks arrive after the last screw goes.
dialogue.phonetic: /snæks əˈraɪv ˈæftər ðə læst skrʊ goʊz/
dialogue.zh: 點心要等最後一顆螺絲鎖完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not lean your whole weight in.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt lin jʊr hoʊl weɪt ɪn/
dialogue.zh: 別把全身重量壓上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I leaned, we both moved, oops.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lind wi boʊθ muvd ups/
dialogue.zh: 我靠了一下，我們兩人都歪了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oops is fine, nobody got hurt.
dialogue.phonetic: /ups ɪz faɪn ˈnoʊbədi gɑt hɜrt/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，沒有人受傷。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No one is hurt, my back just aches.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ wʌn ɪz hɜrt maɪ bæk dʒʌst eɪks/
dialogue.zh: 沒人受傷，只是我背痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stand up, roll your shoulders once.
dialogue.phonetic: /stænd ʌp roʊl jʊr ˈʃoʊldərz wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 站起來，轉一下肩膀。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Shoulders done, now whose turn is holding?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃoʊldərz dʌn naʊ huz tɜrn ɪz ˈhoʊldɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 肩膀好了，換誰來扶？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My turn, you go find the dowels.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ tɜrn ju goʊ faɪnd ðə ˈdaʊəlz/
dialogue.zh: 換我扶，你去把木釘找出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dowels are small, check the little bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdaʊəlz ɑr smɔl tʃɛk ðə ˈlɪtəl bæg/
dialogue.zh: 木釘很小，去看那個小袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here they are, eight wooden pins.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ðeɪ ɑr eɪt ˈwʊdən pɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 在這裡，八根木釘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pins into the holes, then push gently.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪnz ˈɪntu ðə hoʊlz ðɛn pʊʃ ˈdʒɛntli/
dialogue.zh: 木釘插進孔位，再輕輕推。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pushed, and the panel still sways.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃt ænd ðə ˈpænəl stɪl sweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 推進去了，側板還是會晃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swaying means one hole missed its pin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsweɪɪŋ minz wʌn hoʊl mɪst ɪts pɪn/
dialogue.zh: 會晃就代表有個孔沒插到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which hole? I cannot count that fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ hoʊl aɪ ˈkænɑt kaʊnt ðæt fæst/
dialogue.zh: 哪個孔？我數不了那麼快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count slower, point at each one.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt ˈsloʊər pɔɪnt æt itʃ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 數慢一點，一個一個指。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one is empty, see the gap?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn ɪz ˈɛmpi si ðə gæp/
dialogue.zh: 那個是空的，看到縫了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Empty? Then insert a dowel there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmpi ðɛn ɪnˈsɜrt ə ˈdaʊəl ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 空的？那就補一根木釘進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In it goes, snug as a fist.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ɪt goʊz snʌg æz ə fɪst/
dialogue.zh: 插進去了，緊得像拳頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A fist is too big, use the pin.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə fɪst ɪz tu bɪg juz ðə pɪn/
dialogue.zh: 拳頭太大了，用那根木釘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, I meant snug as new.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri aɪ mɛnt snʌg æz nu/
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我是說緊得像新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snug as new is the right phrase.
dialogue.phonetic: /snʌg æz nu ɪz ðə raɪt freɪz/
dialogue.zh: 「緊得像新的」才是對的說法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two of us make this much faster.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ʌv ʌs meɪk ðɪs mʌtʃ ˈfæstər/
dialogue.zh: 我們兩個人做，快好多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Faster and steadier, honestly speaking.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfæstər ænd ˈstɛdiər ˈɑnəstli ˈspikin/
dialogue.zh: 又快又穩，說實話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Speaking later, right now hold on tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈspikin ˈleɪtər raɪt naʊ hoʊld ɑn taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 說話待會，現在先扶緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tight like this, or loose like before?
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪt laɪk ðɪs ɔr lus laɪk bɪˈfɔr/
dialogue.zh: 像這樣緊，還是像剛剛那樣鬆？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tight, but do not bend the board.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪt bʌt du nɑt bɛnd ðə bɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 要緊，但別把板材弄彎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bending is how panels crack in half.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛndɪŋ ɪz haʊ ˈpænəlz kræk ɪn hæf/
dialogue.zh: 板材就是這樣從中間裂開的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cracked is a very bad word today.
dialogue.phonetic: /krækt ɪz ə ˈvɛri bæd wɜrd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今天最不該聽到「裂開」。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No cracks, I checked every edge twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ kræks aɪ tʃɛkt ˈɛvri ɛdʒ twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 沒有裂縫，每條邊我都查了兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice is careful, thank you for staying.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs ɪz ˈkɛrfəl θæŋk ju fɔr ˈsteɪɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 查兩次很仔細，謝謝你留下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Staying was worth it, it looks upright.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsteɪɪŋ wʌz wɜrθ ɪt ɪt lʊks ˈʌpraɪt/
dialogue.zh: 留下是值得的，它看起來筆直。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Upright at last, what do you think?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌpraɪt æt læst wɑt du ju θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 終於站直了，你覺得怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step seven says the back panel goes on.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp ˈsɛvən sɛz ðə bæk ˈpænəl goʊz ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 第七步說要把背板裝上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does this board look so rough?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dʌz ðɪs bɔrd lʊk soʊ rʌf/
dialogue.zh: 這塊板子怎麼看起來這麼粗糙？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rough means the back side faces out.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌf minz ðə bæk saɪd ˈfeɪsəz aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 粗糙就代表背面朝外了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The finished side should show, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈfɪnɪʃt saɪd ʃʊd ʃoʊ raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 應該要顯示修飾面，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, and it does not today.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ænd ɪt dʌz nɑt təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對，但今天它沒有。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We put it on backwards, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi pʊt ɪt ɑn ˈbækwərdz aɪ θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 我想我們把它裝反了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You think? Look, the groove is outward.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju θɪŋk lʊk ðə gruʊv ɪz ˈaʊtwərd/
dialogue.zh: 你確定？你看，溝槽朝外面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Outward grooves, that is my mistake.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊtwərd gruʊvz ðæt ɪz maɪ mɪˈsteɪk/
dialogue.zh: 溝槽朝外，這是我的錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your mistake, or the manual's picture?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr mɪˈsteɪk ɔr ðə ˈmænjuəlz ˈpɪktʃər/
dialogue.zh: 是你的錯，還是說明書圖的錯？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The picture helped, I ignored it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpɪktʃər hɛlpt aɪ ˌɪɡˈnɔrd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 圖是有用的，是我沒看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ignored it means reversed it, again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɪɡˈnɔrd ɪt minz rɪˈvɜrst ɪt əˈgɛn/
dialogue.zh: 沒看就代表裝反，還得再來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many screws hold this wrong board?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni skrʊz hoʊld ðɪs rɔŋ bɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 這塊裝錯的板子有幾顆螺絲？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight small ones in a straight row.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt smɔl wʌnz ɪn ə streɪt roʊ/
dialogue.zh: 八顆小的，排成一直線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight, so we start from screw one.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt soʊ wi stɑrt frʌm skrʊ wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 八顆，那我們從第一顆開始退。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From one, and keep them in order.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm wʌn ænd kip ðɛm ɪn ˈɔrdər/
