dialogue.zh: 從一顆開始，順序要留住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep them in the bag with the number.
dialogue.phonetic: /kip ðɛm ɪn ðə bæg wɪð ðə ˈnʌmbər/
dialogue.zh: 把它們放在有編號的袋子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One cup for these eight, keep them apart.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn kʌp fɔr ðiz eɪt kiːp ðəm əˈpɑrt/
dialogue.zh: 這八顆放同一個杯子，分開收。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mixing screws is how trouble starts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪksɪŋ skrʊz ɪz haʊ ˈtrʌbəl stɑrts/
dialogue.zh: 螺絲混裝就是麻煩的開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trouble stays in the cup, do not worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtrʌbəl steɪz ɪn ðə kʌp du nɑt ˈwɜri/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩會留在杯子裡，彆擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This first screw is stuck, it will not turn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs fɜrst skrʊ ɪz stʌk ɪt wɪl nɑt tɜrn/
dialogue.zh: 第一顆螺絲卡住了，轉不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stuck screws need patience, not force.
dialogue.phonetic: /stʌk skrʊz nid ˈpeɪʃəns nɑt fɔrs/
dialogue.zh: 卡住的螺絲要有耐心，不能用力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Force? I pushed with my whole palm.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔrs aɪ pʊʃt wɪð maɪ hoʊl pɑm/
dialogue.zh: 用力？我整個手掌都在推。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Palm pushing strips the screw head.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɑm ˈpʊʃɪŋ strɪps ðə skrʊ hɛd/
dialogue.zh: 用掌壓會把螺絲頭磨平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stripped? Please say that is not stripped.
dialogue.phonetic: /strɪpt pliz seɪ ðæt ɪz nɑt strɪpt/
dialogue.zh: 磨平了？請說沒有磨平。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is not, the tip just slipped once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz nɑt ðə tɪp dʒʌst slɪpt wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 沒有磨平，起子頭只是滑了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, I cannot lose another screw head.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd aɪ ˈkænɑt luz əˈnʌðər skrʊ hɛd/
dialogue.zh: 好，我受不了再多一顆壞螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No loss yet, keep turning slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ lɔs jɛt kip ˈtɜrnɪŋ ˈsloʊli/
dialogue.zh: 目前沒損失，繼續慢慢轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Out it comes, next one, then four more.
dialogue.phonetic: /aʊt ɪt kʌmz nɛkst wʌn ðɛn fɔr mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 退出來了，下一顆，再四顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four more, and that board is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr mɔr ænd ðæt bɔrd ɪz fri/
dialogue.zh: 再四顆，那塊板就自由了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free at last, look how thin it is.
dialogue.phonetic: /fri æt læst lʊk haʊ θɪn ɪt ɪz/
dialogue.zh: 終於拆下了，看看它多薄。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thin boards bend when you pull hard.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪn bɔrdz bɛnd wɛn ju pʊl hɑrd/
dialogue.zh: 薄板子你一使力就會彎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am pulling gently, do not panic.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈpʊlɪŋ ˈdʒɛntli du nɑt ˈpænɪk/
dialogue.zh: 我很輕地在拉，彆緊張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Panic is my job, you just pull.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpænɪk ɪz maɪ dʒɑb ju dʒʌst pʊl/
dialogue.zh: 緊張是我的工作，你負責拉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The back panel has a printed edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bæk ˈpænəl hæz ə ˈprɪntɪd ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 背板的邊是有印刷紋的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Printed edge goes facing the room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈprɪntɪd ɛdʒ goʊz ˈfeɪsɪŋ ðə rum/
dialogue.zh: 印刷邊要朝著房間那一面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Facing the room, so the pattern reads.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfeɪsɪŋ ðə rum soʊ ðə ˈpætərn ridz/
dialogue.zh: 朝房間，木紋才看得順。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Reads is nice, now flip it over.
dialogue.phonetic: /ridz ɪz naɪs naʊ flɪp ɪt ˈoʊvər/
dialogue.zh: 看得順就好，現在把它翻過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flip, and hold the top with your hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /flɪp ænd hoʊld ðə tɑp wɪð jʊr hænd/
dialogue.zh: 翻的時候用手扶住上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Holding, careful, the corners are sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhoʊldɪŋ ˈkɛrfəl ðə ˈkɔrnərz ɑr ʃɑrp/
dialogue.zh: 有扶住，小心，邊角很利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sharp corners, no wonder my thumb hurts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃɑrp ˈkɔrnərz noʊ ˈwʌndər maɪ θʌm hɜrts/
dialogue.zh: 邊角利，難怪我拇指會痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thumb is tough, keep flipping now.
dialogue.phonetic: /θʌm ɪz tʌf kip ˈflɪpɪŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 拇指很耐，繼續翻吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flipped, and now the groove hides.
dialogue.phonetic: /flɪpt ænd naʊ ðə gruʊv haɪdz/
dialogue.zh: 翻好了，現在溝槽藏起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hidden groove, that is how it works.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɪdən gruʊv ðæt ɪz haʊ ɪt wɜrks/
dialogue.zh: 溝槽藏住，就是這樣才對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the finished face shows at last.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ˈfɪnɪʃt feɪs ʃoʊz æt læst/
dialogue.zh: 修飾面終於朝外了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At last, now drive the screws back.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt læst naʊ draɪv ðə skrʊz bæk/
dialogue.zh: 終於，現在把螺絲鎖回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Drive them in, but only halfway first.
dialogue.phonetic: /draɪv ðɛm ɪn bʌt ˈoʊnli ˈhæfˌweɪ fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 鎖進去，但先只鎖到一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Halfway first, then tighten all eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæfˌweɪ fɜrst ðɛn ˈtaɪtən ɔl eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 先鎖一半，再把八顆鎖緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why halfway? That feels like extra work.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ˈhæfˌweɪ ðæt filz laɪk ˈɛkstrə wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼鎖一半？感覺多做工。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Halfway lets the board settle flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhæfˌweɪ lɛts ðə bɔrd ˈsɛtəl flæt/
dialogue.zh: 鎖一半讓板子先定位放平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Settled, good, now nothing rocks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛtəld gʊd naʊ ˈnʌθɪŋ rɑks/
dialogue.zh: 定位了，好，現在都不晃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rocks gone, tighten from the middle out.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɑks gɔn ˈtaɪtən frʌm ðə ˈmɪdəl aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 不晃了，從中間往外鎖緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Middle first, then the two far corners.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪdəl fɜrst ðɛn ðə tu fɑr ˈkɔrnərz/
dialogue.zh: 先中間，再兩邊遠角。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Far corners last, that keeps it square.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɑr ˈkɔrnərz læst ðæt kips ɪt skwɛr/
dialogue.zh: 遠角最後鎖，才會保持方正。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Square, straight, and finally the right way.
dialogue.phonetic: /skwɛr streɪt ænd ˈfaɪnəli ðə raɪt weɪ/
dialogue.zh: 方正、筆直，終於方向對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The right way took forty minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə raɪt weɪ tʊk ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnɪts/
dialogue.zh: 對的方向花我們四十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forty minutes for one flipped board.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti ˈmɪnɪts fɔr wʌn flɪpt bɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 四十分鐘只為了翻一塊板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One flipped board, and a better shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn flɪpt bɔrd ænd ə ˈbɛtər ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 翻對一塊板，換來更好的層架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better shelf, worth every undone screw.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər ʃɛlf wɜrθ ˈɛvri ˌʌndˈʌn skrʊ/
dialogue.zh: 更好的層架，值得每顆退下的螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Undone screws teach you step eight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndˈʌn skrʊz titʃ ju stɛp eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 退過的螺絲教會你第八步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Step eight, the feet and the hex key.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp eɪt ðə fiːt ænd ðə hɛks ki/
dialogue.zh: 第八步，腳墊和六角扳手。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the page we read upside down.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə peɪdʒ wi rɛd ˈʌpˌsaɪd daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 對，就是我們倒著看的那一頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Upside down is a real possibility.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌpˌsaɪd daʊn ɪz ə ril ˌpɑsəˈbɪləti/
dialogue.zh: 倒著看真的很可能發生。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Possibility, so mark the top with tape.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌpɑsəˈbɪləti soʊ mɑrk ðə tɑp wɪð teɪp/
dialogue.zh: 既然可能，就用膠帶標出頂面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tape on top, an arrow drawn on it.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪp ɑn tɑp ən ˈæroʊ drɔn ɑn ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 膠帶貼頂面，上面畫一個箭頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An arrow is honest, it always points.
dialogue.phonetic: /ən ˈæroʊ ɪz ˈɑnəst ɪt ˈɔlweɪz pɔɪnts/
dialogue.zh: 箭頭很誠實，它永遠指同一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Honest tape, and a pencil mark too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɑnəst teɪp ænd ə ˈpɛnsəl mɑrk tu/
dialogue.zh: 誠實的膠帶，再加一個鉛筆記號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pencil comes off, tape stays put.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛnsəl kʌmz ɑf teɪp steɪz pʊt/
dialogue.zh: 鉛筆會擦掉，膠帶會留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Comes off means we could lose it.
dialogue.phonetic: /kʌmz ɑf minz wi kʊd luz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 會擦掉就代表標記會不見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then tape twice, cheap insurance here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn teɪp twaɪs tʃip ɪnˈʃʊrəns hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 那就貼兩層膠帶，便宜的保險。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Insurance in furniture work, interesting idea.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈʃʊrəns ɪn ˈfɜrnɪtʃər wɜrk ˈɪntərəstɪŋ aɪˈdiə/
dialogue.zh: 組裝傢俱還有保險，有趣的做法。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Interesting works, the shelf looks correct.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɪntərəstɪŋ wɜrks ðə ʃɛlf lʊks kəˈrɛkt/
dialogue.zh: 有趣但有效，層架看起來對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Correct at last, I like that word.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəˈrɛkt æt læst aɪ laɪk ðæt wɜrd/
dialogue.zh: 終於對了，我喜歡這個詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Words are cheap, pass me the key.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɜrdz ɑr tʃip pæs mi ðə ki/
dialogue.zh: 話很便宜，把那支扳手遞給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The hex key? It is in your pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hɛks ki ɪt ɪz ɪn jʊr ˈpɑkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 六角扳手嗎？它在你的口袋裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My pocket, found it, right inside.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈpɑkɪt faʊnd ɪt raɪt ɪnˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 我的口袋，找到了，就在裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Inside, and now tighten from eight to one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪnˈsaɪd ænd naʊ ˈtaɪtən frʌm eɪt tu wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 在裡面，現在從八號鎖回一號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight to one, every head sits flush.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt tu wʌn ˈɛvri hɛd sɪts flʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 八號到一號，每個螺絲頭都齊平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flush means the screw sits level with wood.
dialogue.phonetic: /flʌʃ minz ðə skrʊ sɪts ˈlɛvəl wɪð wʊd/
dialogue.zh: 齊平就是螺絲跟木板同高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Level with wood, no proud heads left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛvəl wɪð wʊd noʊ praʊd hɛdz lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 跟木板同高，沒有凸出的頭了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Proud heads push the shelf up crooked.
dialogue.phonetic: /praʊd hɛdz pʊʃ ðə ʃɛlf ʌp ˈkrʊkɪd/
dialogue.zh: 凸出的螺絲頭會把層板頂歪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Crooked again? No, check each head twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkrʊkɪd əˈgɛn noʊ tʃɛk itʃ hɛd twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 又歪了？沒有，每顆都查兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twice checked, the panel does not move.
dialogue.phonetic: /twaɪs tʃɛkt ðə ˈpænəl dʌz nɑt muv/
dialogue.zh: 查過兩次，側板都不動了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not moving is the best news today.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈmuvɪŋ ɪz ðə bɛst nuz təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不動是今天最好的消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: News is good, but washers are missing.
dialogue.phonetic: /nuz ɪz gʊd bʌt ˈwɑʃərz ɑr ˈmɪsɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 消息不錯，但墊圈不見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Missing washers roll under the rug.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪsɪŋ ˈwɑʃərz roʊl ˈʌndər ðə rʌɡ/
dialogue.zh: 不見的墊圈都滾到地毯下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under the rug, found two, lift the corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər ðə rʌɡ faʊnd tu lɪft ðə ˈkɔrnər/
dialogue.zh: 地毯下面，找到兩個，掀起角。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two washers, one per screw, that is it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈwɑʃərz wʌn pɜr skrʊ ðæt ɪz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 兩個墊圈，一顆螺絲配一個，剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is it? We reversed a whole panel.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ɪt wi rɪˈvɜrst ə hoʊl ˈpænəl/
dialogue.zh: 剛好？我們可把整塊板裝反過。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Reversed, redone, and sturdier than before.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈvɜrst rɪˈdʌn ænd ˈstɜrdiər ðæn bɪˈfɔr/
dialogue.zh: 裝反、重回，結果比之前更穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sturdier matters, that is the point.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstɜrdiər ˈmætərz ðæt ɪz ðə pɔɪnt/
dialogue.zh: 更穩才要緊，那就是重點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The point we almost missed tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə pɔɪnt wi ˈɔlmoʊst mɪst təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們差點沒抓到重點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tonight, honestly this took the whole day.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt ˈɑnəstli ðɪs tʊk ðə hoʊl deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 今晚說實話，花了一整天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Whole day, one bookshelf, no regrets.
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊl deɪ wʌn ˈbʊkˌʃɛlf noʊ rɪˈgrɛts/
dialogue.zh: 一整天，一個書架，不後悔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No regrets, but my fingers all ache.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ rɪˈgrɛts bʌt maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərz ɔl eɪk/
dialogue.zh: 不後悔，但我手指都在痠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aching fingers mean honest weekend work.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈeɪkɪŋ ˈfɪŋɡərz min ˈɑnəst ˈwikˌend wɜrk/
dialogue.zh: 手指痠代表週末真的有做工。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Weekend work, and tomorrow we use it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwikˌend wɜrk ænd təˈmɑroʊ wi juz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 週末的工，明天就能用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use it, but not for heavy books.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ɪt bʌt nɑt fɔr ˈhɛvi bʊks/
dialogue.zh: 可以用，但先別放很重的書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heavy books come later, one board left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi bʊks kʌm ˈleɪtər wʌn bɔrd lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 重書待會兒，還剩一塊板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One board left, the top, remember?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bɔrd lɛft ðə tɑp rɪˈmɛmbər/
dialogue.zh: 剩一塊板，最上面那片，記得嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Remembered, the top piece waits on you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌrɪˈmɛmbərd ðə tɑp pis weɪts ɑn ju/
dialogue.zh: 記得，最上面那片在等你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It waits, but give me the screwdriver.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt weɪts bʌt gɪv mi ðə ˈskrʊˌdaɪvər/
dialogue.zh: 它會等，但先把螺絲起子給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last board, the top one, on now.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst bɔrd ðə tɑp wʌn ɑn naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 最後一塊板，最上面那片，現在放。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On now, and my wrist is asking why.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn naʊ ænd maɪ rɪst ɪz ˈæskɪŋ waɪ/
dialogue.zh: 現在放，我的手腕在問為什麼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask it later, hand me the driver.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ɪt ˈleɪtər hænd mi ðə ˈdraɪvər/
dialogue.zh: 先別問手腕，把起子遞給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cross head again, it is the only one.
dialogue.phonetic: /krɔs hɛd əˈgɛn ɪt ɪz ði ˈoʊnli wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 又是十字頭，它是唯一能用的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The only one, and the last four holes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈoʊnli wʌn ænd ðə læst fɔr hoʊlz/
dialogue.zh: 唯一那支，還有最後四個孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four holes, four screws, no spare today.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr hoʊlz fɔr skrʊz noʊ spɛr təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 四個孔、四顆螺絲，今天不缺料。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No spare? Bag two still holds six.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ spɛr bæɡ tu stɪl hoʊldz sɪks/
dialogue.zh: 沒有備用？二號袋還有六顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four go in, and two stay in the cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr goʊ ɪn ænd tu steɪ ɪn ðə kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 四顆鎖進去，另外兩顆放杯子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep them there, then we lift this top board.
dialogue.phonetic: /kiːp ðɛm ðɛr ðɛn wi lɪft ðɪs tɑp bɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 先把它們放著，再把頂板抬上去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lifting, hold your end, it is long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪftɪŋ hoʊld jʊr ɛnd ɪt ɪz lɔŋ/
dialogue.zh: 抬起來了，你扶你那一頭，很長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Long boards need two people, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ bɔrdz nid tu ˈpipəl ˈɔlweɪz/
dialogue.zh: 長板子永遠需要兩個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two people, one board, easy now.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈpipəl wʌn bɔrd ˈizi naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 兩個人、一塊板，現在輕鬆多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Easy, but do not drop it on my foot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈizi bʌt du nɑt drɑp ɪt ɑn maɪ fʊt/
dialogue.zh: 輕鬆，但別掉到我的腳上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your foot is safe, the board is down.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr fʊt ɪz seɪf ðə bɔrd ɪz daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 你的腳很安全，板子放下了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down on the brackets, does it sit?
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn ɑn ðə ˈbrækəts dʌz ɪt sɪt/
dialogue.zh: 落在托架上了，它坐得穩嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sitting, but one end wants a push.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪtɪŋ bʌt wʌn ɛnd wɑnts ə pʊʃ/
dialogue.zh: 坐上去了，但有一頭還需推。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Push until you hear a small click.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊʃ ʌnˈtɪl ju hɪr ə smɔl klɪk/
dialogue.zh: 推到聽見一聲小小的咔噠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Click, got it, both ends are seated.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪk gɑt ɪt boʊθ ɛndz ɑr ˈsitəd/
dialogue.zh: 咔噠，接到了，兩邊都定位了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seated boards do not move at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsitəd bɔrdz du nɑt muv æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 定位好的板子都不會動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At all, not even when I press.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt ɔl nɑt ˈivən wɛn aɪ prɛs/
dialogue.zh: 完全不動，我壓下去也不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press is the test, press harder.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ɪz ðə tɛst prɛs ˈhɑrdər/
dialogue.zh: 壓就是測試，再壓重一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Harder, and the whole unit stays quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɑrdər ænd ðə hoʊl ˈjunɪt steɪz ˈkwaɪət/
dialogue.zh: 更重壓，整件還是不出聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Quiet means no gaps, that is good.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkwaɪət minz noʊ gæps ðæt ɪz gʊd/
dialogue.zh: 不出聲代表沒有縫，很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, now drive the last four screws.
dialogue.phonetic: /gʊd naʊ draɪv ðə læst fɔr skrʊz/
dialogue.zh: 好，現在鎖最後四顆螺絲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First one, two turns, then stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrst wʌn tu tɜrnz ðɛn stɑp/
dialogue.zh: 第一顆，轉兩圈，然後停。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stop when the head touches the surface.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑp wɛn ðə hɛd ˈtʌtʃəz ðə ˈsɜrfəs/
dialogue.zh: 螺絲頭碰到板面就停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Touches is not tight, give it a quarter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtʌtʃəz ɪz nɑt taɪt gɪv ɪt ə ˈkwɔrtər/
dialogue.zh: 才碰到還不算緊，再轉四分之一圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A quarter turn, careful, do not strip.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkwɔrtər tɜrn ˈkɛrfəl du nɑt strɪp/
dialogue.zh: 四分之一圈，小心，別轉滑牙。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I know, stripped heads are my fear.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ strɪpt hɛdz ɑr maɪ fir/
dialogue.zh: 我知道，滑牙是我最怕的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No fear, my wrist is doing it.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ fir maɪ rɪst ɪz ˈduɪŋ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 別怕，我的手腕在輕輕用力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Doing well, one more, only two left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈduɪŋ wɛl wʌn mɔr ˈoʊnli tu lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 鎖得不錯，再一顆，只剩兩顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two left, and my hand is shaking.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu lɛft ænd maɪ hænd ɪz ˈʃeɪkɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 剩兩顆，我的手在抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shaking hands still drive screws fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʃeɪkɪŋ hændz stɪl draɪv skrʊz faɪn/
dialogue.zh: 抖的手一樣能把螺絲鎖好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine is a low bar, but yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn ɪz ə loʊ bɑr bʌt jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 「還行」標準有點低，但對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes to the bar, now the last screw.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs tu ðə bɑr naʊ ðə læst skrʊ/
dialogue.zh: 就這個標準吧，現在最後一顆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Last screw, count with me, one more.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst skrʊ kaʊnt wɪð mi wʌn mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 最後一顆，跟我一起數，再一圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more, and we are finished here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ænd wi ɑr ˈfɪnɪʃt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 再一圈，我們這邊就收工了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finished here, but check the sides again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪnɪʃt hɪr bʌt tʃɛk ðə saɪdz əˈgɛn/
dialogue.zh: 收工了，但兩側再檢查一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Again? I checked each side twice.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈgɛn aɪ tʃɛkt itʃ saɪd twaɪs/
dialogue.zh: 又檢查？每邊我都查兩次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check once more for wobble, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk wʌns mɔr fɔr ˈwɑbəl pliz/
dialogue.zh: 再查一次會不會晃，拜託。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wobble test, I lean on the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɑbəl tɛst aɪ lin ɑn ðə ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 晃度測試，我靠向層板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leaning is not testing, use your hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlinɪŋ ɪz nɑt ˈtɛstɪŋ juz jʊr hænd/
dialogue.zh: 靠上去不算測試，用手推。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hand pushes, the shelf does not move.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hænd ˈpʊʃəz ðə ʃɛlf dʌz nɑt muv/
dialogue.zh: 我的手推下去，層板都不動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No movement, that is a real shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈmuvmənt ðæt ɪz ə ril ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 一動不動，那才是真的層板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A real shelf after six hours, wow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ril ʃɛlf ˈæftər sɪks ˈaʊərz waʊ/
dialogue.zh: 六個小時後真的有層架了，哇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six hours, and the box said two.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks ˈaʊərz ænd ðə bɑks sɛd tu/
dialogue.zh: 六個小時，箱子明明寫兩小時。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The box lied about the assembly time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɑks laɪd əˈbaʊt ði əˈsɛmbli taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 箱子在組裝時間上騙人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lied or not, the level still works.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪd ɔr nɑt ðə ˈlɛvəl stɪl wɜrks/
dialogue.zh: 騙不騙，水平尺還是有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Level once more, on the top board.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɛvəl wʌns mɔr ɑn ðə tɑp bɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 再量一次水平，在最上層板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bubble centered, floor bumps forgiven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʌbəl ˈsɛntərd flɔr bʌmps fərˈgɪvən/
dialogue.zh: 氣泡在中間，地板的坑原諒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Forgiven floor, now stand back and look.
dialogue.phonetic: /fərˈgɪvən flɔr naʊ stænd bæk ænd lʊk/
dialogue.zh: 原諒地板了，往後站再看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Standing back, it is taller than I thought.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈstændɪŋ bæk ɪt ɪz ˈtɔlər ðæn aɪ θɔt/
dialogue.zh: 往後站，它比我想像的高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Taller and straighter than the picture.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɔlər ænd ˈstreɪtər ðæn ðə ˈpɪktʃər/
dialogue.zh: 比圖片裡更高也更直。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The picture never shows the dust.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpɪktʃər ˈnɛvər ʃoʊz ðə dʌst/
dialogue.zh: 圖片從不會拍出那些灰塵。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dust, cardboard bits, and screw bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌst ˈkɑrdˌbɔrd bɪts ænd skrʊ bægz/
dialogue.zh: 灰塵、紙板碎屑、螺絲袋。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bits everywhere, we made a mess.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪts ˈɛvriˌwɛr wi meɪd ə mɛs/
dialogue.zh: 碎屑滿地，我們製造了一片亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A mess, but a useful mess today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə mɛs bʌt ə ˈjusəl mɛs təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 亂，但今天是有用的亂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Useful mess, sweep it after coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjusəl mɛs swip ɪt ˈæftər ˈkɔfi/
dialogue.zh: 有用的亂，喝完咖啡再掃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sweep later, wipe the boards first.
dialogue.phonetic: /swip ˈleɪtər waɪp ðə bɔrdz fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 晚點再掃，先把板子擦一擦。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wipe the prints off the front edge.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪp ðə prɪnts ɔf ðə frʌnt ɛdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 把前面的指紋擦掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Front edge clean, the caps are next.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌnt ɛdʒ klin ðə kæps ɑr nɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 前面擦乾淨了，下一步是蓋帽。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Caps hide screws, the small round ones.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæps haɪd skrʊz ðə smɔl raʊnd wʌnz/
dialogue.zh: 蓋帽蓋住螺絲，圓圓那種小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Round caps press on with a thumb.
dialogue.phonetic: /raʊnd kæps prɛs ɑn wɪð ə θʌm/
dialogue.zh: 圓蓋帽用拇指按進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thumb pressed, now it looks designed.
dialogue.phonetic: /θʌm prɛst naʊ ɪt lʊks dɪˈzaɪnd/
dialogue.zh: 拇指按好了，看起來像設計過的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Designed is a strong word for us.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪˈzaɪnd ɪz ə strɔŋ wɜrd fɔr ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 「設計過」對我們是太重的詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Strong word, but look at that line.
dialogue.phonetic: /strɔŋ wɜrd bʌt lʊk æt ðæt laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 詞太重，但你看那條線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That line is the shelf, dead straight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt laɪn ɪz ðə ʃɛlf dɛd streɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那條線就是層板，筆直筆直的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dead straight, I will take a photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɛd streɪt aɪ wɪl teɪk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 筆直沒錯，我要拍一張照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Photo? After we move it from the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfoʊtoʊ ˈæftər wi muv ɪt frʌm ðə wɔl/
dialogue.zh: 拍照？先把它從牆邊移開再說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move it out, check the wall gap first.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ɪt aʊt tʃɛk ðə wɔl gæp fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 先移出來，再量牆邊的縫。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wall gap, one finger fits, that is right.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɔl gæp wʌn ˈfɪŋɡər fɪts ðæt ɪz raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 牆邊的縫，一個手指剛好，對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, air behind, boards in front.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt ɛr bɪˈhaɪnd bɔrdz ɪn frʌnt/
dialogue.zh: 對，後面透氣，板子在前。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In front of the wall, not touching.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn frʌnt ʌv ðə wɔl nɑt ˈtʌtʃɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 在牆前面，但沒有碰到牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not touching means no scratches tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈtʌtʃɪŋ minz noʊ ˈskrætʃəz təˈmɑroʊ/
dialogue.zh: 不碰牆，明天就不會有刮痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Scratch free, and it holds the weight.
dialogue.phonetic: /skrætʃ fri ænd ɪt hoʊldz ðə weɪt/
dialogue.zh: 沒刮痕，而且它撐得住重量。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Weight test comes with the books soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt tɛst kʌmz wɪð ðə bʊks sun/
dialogue.zh: 真正的重量測試是放書的時候。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Soon, but the top board is still bare.
dialogue.phonetic: /sun bʌt ðə tɑp bɔrd ɪz stɪl bɛr/
dialogue.zh: 很快，但最上層還是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bare tops collect dust and light.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛr tɑps kəˈlɛkt dʌst ænd laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 空板面會累積灰塵和光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Dust and light, and maybe a plant.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌst ænd laɪt ænd ˈmeɪbi ə plænt/
dialogue.zh: 灰塵和光，也許再加一盆植物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drill there and the thin board cracks.
dialogue.phonetic: /drɪl ðɛr ænd ðə θɪn bɔrd kræks/
dialogue.zh: 在那裡鑽孔，薄板會裂開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cracks, no thanks, the plant sits aside.
dialogue.phonetic: /kræks noʊ θæŋks ðə plænt sɪts əˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 裂開就免了，植物放旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Aside works, the shelf is complete.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈsaɪd wɜrks ðə ʃɛlf ɪz kəmˈplit/
dialogue.zh: 放旁邊也可以，這層架完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Complete, say it again, I cannot hear.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəmˈplit seɪ ɪt əˈgɛn aɪ ˈkænɑt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 完成？再說一次，我剛沒聽清。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Complete! The bookshelf is finished.
dialogue.phonetic: /kəmˈplit ðə ˈbʊkˌʃɛlf ɪz ˈfɪnɪʃt/
dialogue.zh: 完成了！書架全部組好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Finished, and my hand still hurts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɪnɪʃt ænd maɪ hænd stɪl hɜrts/
dialogue.zh: 組好了，但我的手還在痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hurting hand, but nothing is loose.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɜrtɪŋ hænd bʌt ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪz lus/
dialogue.zh: 手會痛，但沒有一顆是鬆的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Loose is the word I feared most.
dialogue.phonetic: /lus ɪz ðə wɜrd aɪ fɪrd moʊst/
dialogue.zh: 「鬆」是我最怕聽到那個詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Feared no more, shake it, nothing moves.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪrd noʊ mɔr ʃeɪk ɪt ˈnʌθɪŋ muvz/
dialogue.zh: 不用怕了，搖一下，都沒動。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nothing moves, I want to sit down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnʌθɪŋ muvz aɪ wɑnt tu sɪt daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 都沒動，我想坐下來一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sit on the floor, we earned a rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt ɑn ðə flɔr wi ɜrnd ə rɛst/
dialogue.zh: 坐在地板上，我們值得休息一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A rest, and then the books arrive.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə rɛst ænd ðɛn ðə bʊks əˈraɪv/
dialogue.zh: 休息一下，然後書就搬過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Books wait outside, this shelf is ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʊks weɪt ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðɪs ʃɛlf ɪz ˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 書在門外等，這層架準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ready shelf, ready me, almost both.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɛdi ʃɛlf ˈrɛdi mi ˈɔlmoʊst boʊθ/
dialogue.zh: 層架準備好，我也差不多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both ready, take one look at it.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ ˈrɛdi teɪk wʌn lʊk æt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 兩邊都好了，再好好看一眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One look, from the doorway, right there.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn lʊk frʌm ðə ˈdɔrˌweɪ raɪt ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 看一眼，從門口那裡，就那個角度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: From the doorway it really looks bought.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm ðə ˈdɔrˌweɪ ɪt ˈrɪəli lʊks bɔt/
dialogue.zh: 從門口看，它真的像買回來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bought is the best compliment, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɔt ɪz ðə bɛst ˈkɑmpləmənt ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 「像買來的」是最大的稱讚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Compliment accepted, now get the books.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑmpləmənt ɪkˈsɛptəd naʊ gɛt ðə bʊks/
dialogue.zh: 稱讚我收下了，去把書拿來吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Books in twenty minutes, camera first.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʊks ɪn ˈtwɛnti ˈmɪnɪts ˈkæməra fɜrst/
dialogue.zh: 二十分鐘後放書，相機先來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Camera first, the shelf must pose empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæməra fɜrst ðə ʃɛlf mʌst poʊz ˈɛmpi/
dialogue.zh: 相機先來，層架要先空著入鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The books are waiting, stack them here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bʊks ɑr ˈweɪtɪŋ stæk ðɛm hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 書在等著，先堆在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Stack them here, the shelf is strong now.
dialogue.phonetic: /stæk ðɛm hɪr ðə ʃɛlf ɪz strɔŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 堆在這裡，層架現在很堅固。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Heavy ones low, light ones high.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhɛvi wʌnz loʊ laɪt wʌnz haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 重的放低，輕的放高。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Low for weight, high for the eye.
dialogue.phonetic: /loʊ fɔr weɪt haɪ fɔr ði aɪ/
dialogue.zh: 低放是為了重量，高放是為了好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The cookbooks go at eye level.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkʊkˌbʊks goʊ æt aɪ ˈlɛvəl/
dialogue.zh: 食譜放在眼睛高度那層。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cookbooks need their own wide shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʊkˌbʊks nid ðɛr oʊn waɪd ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 食譜需要一塊自己的寬層板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wide shelf taken, the notebooks fit.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪd ʃɛlf ˈteɪkən ðə ˈnoʊtˌbʊks fɪt/
dialogue.zh: 寬層板被佔了，筆記本剛好放得下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Notebooks stand better in a row.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnoʊtˌbʊks stænd ˈbɛtər ɪn ə roʊ/
dialogue.zh: 筆記本排成一排站得最好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In a row, or leaning on bookends?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪn ə roʊ ɔr ˈlinɪŋ ɑn ˈbʊkˌɛndz/
dialogue.zh: 排成一排，還是用書檔倚著？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bookends hold them, no leaning towers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbʊkˌɛndz hoʊld ðɛm noʊ ˈlinɪŋ ˈtaʊərz/
dialogue.zh: 書檔會扶住，不會歪成高塔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Leaning towers is what mine became.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlinɪŋ ˈtaʊərz ɪz wɑt maɪn bəˈkeɪm/
dialogue.zh: 歪成高塔就是我那一排的下場。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yours stood, mine fell with three books.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɔrz stʊd maɪn fɛl wɪð θri bʊks/
dialogue.zh: 你那排站住了，我那排倒了三本書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Three books fell, no damage, no fear.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri bʊks fɛl noʊ ˈdæmɪdʒ noʊ fir/
dialogue.zh: 掉了三本書，沒損壞，也別嚇。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No damage to books, check the board.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈdæmɪdʒ tu bʊks tʃɛk ðə bɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 書沒傷到，倒是檢查板子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The board is fine, a small mark only.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bɔrd ɪz faɪn ə smɔl mɑrk ˈoʊnli/
dialogue.zh: 板子還好，只有一點小痕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small marks hide behind the tall books.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl mɑrks haɪd bɪˈhaɪnd ðə tɔl bʊks/
dialogue.zh: 小痕跡藏在那些高書後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tall books on the second shelf, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɔl bʊks ɑn ðə ˈsɛkənd ʃɛlf ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 那高書就放第二層嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Second shelf takes them, no pushing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛkənd ʃɛlf teɪks ðɛm noʊ ˈpʊʃɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 第二層收下了，不用硬塞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pushing is needed, the space is tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpʊʃɪŋ ɪz ˈnidəd ðə speɪs ɪz taɪt/
dialogue.zh: 還是要推，因為空間很緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tight space means a narrower shelf load.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪt speɪs minz ə ˈnæroʊər ʃɛlf loʊd/
dialogue.zh: 空間緊就代表別塞太多書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Narrower load, leave a finger of air.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnæroʊər loʊd liv ə ˈfɪŋɡər ʌv ɛr/
dialogue.zh: 少塞一點，留一個手指的空隙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A finger of air, then books again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈfɪŋɡər ʌv ɛr ðɛn bʊks əˈgɛn/
dialogue.zh: 留一指的空氣，然後再放書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Books again, and the poetry set last.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʊks əˈgɛn ænd ðə ˈpoʊətri sɛt læst/
dialogue.zh: 書再放上去，詩集留到最後。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Poetry last, it is light, it waits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpoʊətri læst ɪt ɪz laɪt ɪt weɪts/
dialogue.zh: 詩集最後，它很輕，它可以等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It waits on top, the highest row.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt weɪts ɑn tɑp ðə ˈhaɪəst roʊ/
dialogue.zh: 它在最上面那排等著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Highest row needs a chair, not tiptoes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈhaɪəst roʊ nidz ə tʃɛr nɑt ˈtɪpˌtoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 最高那排要用椅子，別踮腳。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tiptoes are risky, take the small chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɪpˌtoʊz ɑr ˈrɪski teɪk ðə smɔl tʃɛr/
dialogue.zh: 踮腳很危險，拿那張小椅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Small chair taken, steady under you.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl tʃɛr ˈteɪkən ˈstɛdi ˈʌndər ju/
dialogue.zh: 小椅子搬來了，在你腳下很穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Under me, steady, and the top row done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈʌndər mi ˈstɛdi ænd ðə tɑp roʊ dʌn/
dialogue.zh: 在腳下很穩，最上面一排完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done up there, now look at it down here.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn ʌp ðɛr naʊ lʊk æt ɪt daʊn hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 上面完成了，從下面再看一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Down here it looks full, but tidy.
dialogue.phonetic: /daʊn hɪr ɪt lʊks fʊl bʌt ˈtaɪdi/
dialogue.zh: 從下面看它很滿，但很整齊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full and tidy is a fine result.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʊl ænd ˈtaɪdi ɪz ə faɪn rɪˈzʌlt/
dialogue.zh: 又滿又整齊就是好結果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Result, yes, and my coffee is cold.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈzʌlt jɛs ænd maɪ ˈkɔfi ɪz koʊld/
dialogue.zh: 結果是好的，但我的咖啡涼了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cold coffee, warm shelf, take the photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /koʊld ˈkɔfi wɔrm ʃɛlf teɪk ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 咖啡涼的，層架是暖的，拍照吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The photo? Now, with that light?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ naʊ wɪð ðæt laɪt/
dialogue.zh: 現在拍照？用那個光線？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That light is best, from the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt laɪt ɪz bɛst frʌm ðə ˈwɪndoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 窗邊那個光線最好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: From the window, stand a little back.
dialogue.phonetic: /frʌm ðə ˈwɪndoʊ stænd ə ˈlɪtəl bæk/
dialogue.zh: 從窗邊來，你往後站一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back enough that the whole shelf fits.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk ɪˈnʌf ðæt ðə hoʊl ʃɛlf fɪts/
dialogue.zh: 後退到整組層架都進得了鏡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fits the shelf, not my elbow, careful.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɪts ðə ʃɛlf nɑt maɪ ˈɛloʊ ˈkɛrfəl/
dialogue.zh: 層架進鏡了，我的手肘沒有，小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your elbow is out, hold the phone high.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊr ˈɛloʊ ɪz aʊt hoʊld ðə foʊn haɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你手肘出去了，把手機舉高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phone high, level, and do not shake.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊn haɪ ˈlɛvəl ænd du nɑt ʃeɪk/
dialogue.zh: 手機舉高、抓水平，別抖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I am steady, count to three for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈstɛdi kaʊnt tu θri fɔr mi/
dialogue.zh: 我很穩，幫我數到三。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One, two, three, that is one taken.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tu θri ðæt ɪz wʌn ˈteɪkən/
dialogue.zh: 一、二、三，那是一張拍好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One taken, show me, let me see.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ˈteɪkən ʃoʊ mi lɛt mi si/
dialogue.zh: 一張拍好了，給我看看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See it? The gap on the left shows.
dialogue.phonetic: /si ɪt ðə gæp ɑn ðə lɛft ʃoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 看到了嗎？左邊那個空位很明顯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gap shows books, not bare wood.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə gæp ʃoʊz bʊks nɑt bɛr wʊd/
dialogue.zh: 那個空位應該放書，不是空木板。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bare wood is what I wanted gone.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɛr wʊd ɪz wɑt aɪ ˈwɑntɪd gɔn/
dialogue.zh: 空木板就是我想消滅的東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gone it is, fill it with paperbacks.
dialogue.phonetic: /gɔn ɪt ɪz fɪl ɪt wɪð ˈpeɪpərˌbæks/
dialogue.zh: 它不見了，用平裝書填滿它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paperbacks in, the thin row closes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpərˌbæks ɪn ðə θɪn roʊ ˈkloʊzəz/
dialogue.zh: 平裝書放進去，那排細縫闔上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Closes nicely, nothing tilts sideways now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkloʊzəz ˈnaɪsli ˈnʌθɪŋ tɪlts ˈsaɪdweɪz naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 闔得很漂亮，現在沒有東西斜了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sideways is the enemy of shelves.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsaɪdweɪz ɪz ði ˈɛnəmi ʌv ʃɛlvz/
dialogue.zh: 歪斜是層架的天敵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enemy beaten, the manual goes where?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛnəmi ˈbitən ðə ˈmænjuəl goʊz wɛr/
dialogue.zh: 天敵打敗了，那說明書要放哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where? In the drawer with the extra bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ɪn ðə drɔər wɪð ði ˈɛkstrə bægz/
dialogue.zh: 哪裡？放在備用袋那個抽屜。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drawer, agreed, keep the paper together.
dialogue.phonetic: /drɔər əˈgrid kip ðə ˈpeɪpər təˈgɛðər/
dialogue.zh: 抽屜，我同意，紙本放一起。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Paper together, and the key in the bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpər təˈgɛðər ænd ðə ki ɪn ðə bæg/
dialogue.zh: 紙本放一起，扳手放回袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hex key in the screw bag, taped shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛks ki ɪn ðə skrʊ bæg teɪp ʃʌt/
dialogue.zh: 六角扳手放螺絲袋，用膠帶封好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Taped shut, the carton goes outside.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪp ʃʌt ðə ˈkɑrtɑn goʊz ˌaʊtˈsaɪd/
dialogue.zh: 封好了，紙箱拿到門外去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Outside, folded flat, recycling day comes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ˈfoʊldəd flæt ˌrisaɪˈklɪŋ deɪ kʌmz/
dialogue.zh: 外面、壓扁，回收日會來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Recycling is easy, my back is not.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌrisaɪˈklɪŋ ɪz ˈizi maɪ bæk ɪz nɑt/
dialogue.zh: 回收很容易，我的腰就不是了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not easy, but look at that shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈizi bʌt lʊk æt ðæt ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 是不容易，但你看那個層架。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That shelf holds forty books already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ʃɛlf hoʊldz ˈfɔrti bʊks ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 那層架已經放了四十本書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Forty books, and room for twenty more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɔrti bʊks ænd rum fɔr ˈtwɛnti mɔr/
dialogue.zh: 四十本，還放得下二十本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty more, do not get greedy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtwɛnti mɔr du nɑt ɡɛt ˈgridi/
dialogue.zh: 再二十本，別貪心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Greedy? I only want one more shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈgridi aɪ ˈoʊnli wɑnt wʌn mɔr ʃɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 貪心？我只想要多一層。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more shelf, and this one is full.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr ʃɛlf ænd ðɪs wʌn ɪz fʊl/
dialogue.zh: 多一層再說，但這層已經滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Full is honest, the photo shows it.
dialogue.phonetic: /fʊl ɪz ˈɑnəst ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ ʃoʊz ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 滿是很誠實的，照片拍得出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shows it well, send it to the group.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃoʊz ɪt wɛl sɛnd ɪt tu ðə ɡrup/
dialogue.zh: 拍得很好，傳到群組去吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The group chat wants before and after.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡrup tʃæt wɑnts bɪˈfɔr ænd ˈæftər/
dialogue.zh: 群組要的是對比照。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Before, four flat boxes on the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɪˈfɔr fɔr flæt ˈbɑksɪz ɑn ðə flɔr/
dialogue.zh: 之前是地板上四個扁扁的箱子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: After is this, books and one plant.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæftər ɪz ðɪs bʊks ænd wʌn plænt/
dialogue.zh: 之後是這個，書加一盆植物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One plant aside, remember the thin board.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn plænt əˈsaɪd rɪˈmɛmbər ðə θɪn bɔrd/
dialogue.zh: 植物放旁邊，記得那塊薄板。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Remembered well, no drilling on that one.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈmɛmbərd wɛl noʊ ˈdrɪlɪŋ ɑn ðæt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 記得清楚，那一塊不鑽孔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one holds albums, light and flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌn hoʊldz ˈælbʊmz laɪt ænd flæt/
dialogue.zh: 那層放相本，又輕又扁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Albums are heavy too, check the sag.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈælbʊmz ɑr ˈhɛvi tu tʃɛk ðə sæg/
dialogue.zh: 相本其實也重，看看垂不垂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sag? No sag, the middle holds firm.
dialogue.phonetic: /sæg noʊ sæg ðə ˈmɪdəl hoʊldz fɜrm/
dialogue.zh: 垂？沒有垂，中間撐得很緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Firm middle, firm edges, we did well.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɜrm ˈmɪdəl fɜrm ˈɛdʒɪz wi dɪd wɛl/
dialogue.zh: 中間緊、邊邊也緊，我們做得好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We did well, and Sam gets a copy.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi dɪd wɛl ænd sæm gɛts ə ˈkɑpi/
dialogue.zh: 我們做得好，山姆也要一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A copy for him, one for the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkɑpi fɔr hɪm wʌn fɔr ðə frɪdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 給他一張，還有一張貼冰箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fridge, yes, proof that we built it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə frɪdʒ jɛs pruf ðæt wi bɪlt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 貼冰箱，對，是我們自己組的證據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Proof by photo, and by that hex key.
dialogue.phonetic: /pruf baɪ ˈfoʊtoʊ ænd baɪ ðæt hɛks ki/
dialogue.zh: 照片是證據，那支六角扳手也是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hex key proof, now clean up the dust.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛks ki pruf naʊ klin ʌp ðə dʌst/
dialogue.zh: 扳手是證據，現在來清灰塵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Dust is gone, the floor shows again.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌst ɪz gɔn ðə flɔr ʃoʊz əˈgɛn/
dialogue.zh: 灰塵清光了，地板又看得見了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Floor again, driver back from Lin, rug flat.
dialogue.phonetic: /flɔr əˈgɛn ˈdraɪvər bæk frʌm lɪn rʌɡ flæt/
dialogue.zh: 地板又見了光，鈴那支起子也還來了，地毯鋪平。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rug flat, level back to Sam, all sorted.
dialogue.phonetic: /rʌɡ flæt ˈlɛvəl bæk tu sæm ɔl ˈsɔrtəd/
dialogue.zh: 地毯鋪平，水平尺還給山姆，全都收好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All sorted, my hands can rest today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ˈsɔrtəd maɪ hændz kæn rɛst təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 全都整理好了，我的手今天能休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest them, the shelf will wait tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst ðɛm ðə ʃɛlf wɪl weɪt təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 讓手休息吧，層架今晚會等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It waits forever now, it is solid.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt weɪts fərˈɛvər naʊ ɪt ɪz ˈsɑlɪd/
dialogue.zh: 它現在能等很久，它很堅固。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Solid, quiet, level, and finally facing out.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑlɪd ˈkwaɪət ˈlɛvəl ænd ˈfaɪnəli ˈfeɪsɪŋ aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 堅固、安靜、水平，而且正面朝外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Facing out, the finished side, at last.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfeɪsɪŋ aʊt ðə ˈfɪnɪʃt saɪd æt læst/
dialogue.zh: 朝外了，修飾面，終於對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At last, one more photo, just for fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt læst wʌn mɔr ˈfoʊtoʊ dʒʌst fɔr fʌn/
dialogue.zh: 終於，再拍一張，只是開心的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: For fun only, the light fell nicely.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr fʌn ˈoʊnli ðə laɪt fɛl ˈnaɪsli/
dialogue.zh: 開心就好，光線落得剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Light fell, books stand, done for today.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪt fɛl bʊks stænd dʌn fɔr təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 光線落、書站好，今天收工。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, but two screws sit in the cup.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn bʌt tu skrʊz sɪt ɪn ðə kʌp/
dialogue.zh: 收工了，但有兩顆螺絲留在杯子裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The two spares from bag two, never needed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tu spɛrz frʌm bæɡ tu ˈnɛvər ˈnidɪd/
dialogue.zh: 那是二號袋的兩顆備用，根本沒用上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So nothing is missing, only spares.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈnʌθɪŋ ɪz ˈmɪsɪŋ ˈoʊnli spɛrz/
dialogue.zh: 所以沒有少零件，只是多出來的備用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tape them in the drawer, smart move.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪp ðɛm ɪn ðə drɔr smɑrt muv/
dialogue.zh: 把它們用膠帶貼在抽屜裡，聰明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart part, and the shelf is ours now.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt pɑrt ænd ðə ʃɛlf ɪz ˈaʊərz naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明的部分，現在這層架是我們的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours now, built by two, in one day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊərz naʊ bɪlt baɪ tu ɪn wʌn deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 是我們的，兩人一天組出來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One day, one shelf, one good photo.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn deɪ wʌn ʃɛlf wʌn gʊd ˈfoʊtoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 一天、一層架、一張好照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One good photo, and sleep at last.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn gʊd ˈfoʊtoʊ ænd slip æt læst/
dialogue.zh: 一張好照片，然後終於可以睡了。
